countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte ضرر The Darkin Blade ويشلّ Aatrox إن صدّ شلّ حركة.
countered_by.why_en: Riposte parries The Darkin Blade's damage and stuns Aatrox if it blocks an immobilizing effect.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Aatrox بـ Mega Adhesive ويثبّته على الأرض فيوقف Umbral Dash.
countered_by.why_en: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds Aatrox, stopping his Umbral Dash.

countered_by.why_ar: تعلّم Aatrox بـ Flame Breath لضرر من أقصى الصحة عند الضربة، وتُنهكه نار Burnout.
countered_by.why_en: Flame Breath marks Aatrox for max-Health on-hit damage, and Burnout's fire wears him down.

counters.why_ar: تراوغ ضربات The Darkin Blade الواسعة وUmbral Dash Nasus الذي يحتاج Wither إلى المدى القريب.
counters.why_en: The Darkin Blade's wide swings and Umbral Dash kite Nasus, whose Wither needs melee range.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Deathbringer Stance من أقصى الصحة وعلاج Umbral Dash على Dr. Mundo في الاستمرارية، وتثبّته Infernal Chains في مكانه.
counters.why_en: Deathbringer Stance's max-Health damage and Umbral Dash's healing out-sustain Dr. Mundo, and Infernal Chains pins him in place.

counters.why_ar: يغلق Umbral Dash المسافة نحو Fiddlesticks، وتسحبه Infernal Chains، ويعالج Aatrox بـ Deathbringer Stance.
counters.why_en: Umbral Dash closes on Fiddlesticks, Infernal Chains drags him back, and Deathbringer Stance heals Aatrox.

countered_by.why_ar: يقطع رعب Doom 'N Gloom اندفاعات Ahri ومنها Spirit Rush.
countered_by.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom's fear interrupts Ahri's dashes, including Spirit Rush.

countered_by.why_ar: تنيم Ahri بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble بعد Spirit Rush.
countered_by.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Ahri to sleep after Spirit Rush.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف شلل Pyromania مهارة Spirit Rush، ويخفف Molten Shield ضرر Orb of Deception.
countered_by.why_en: Pyromania's stun stops Spirit Rush, and Molten Shield blunts Orb of Deception.

counters.why_ar: توقف Charm اندفاع Mortal Steel وانتقال Fate Sealed الفوري، ويتلقى Yone ضررًا أكبر من Ahri.
counters.why_en: Charm stops Mortal Steel's dash and Fate Sealed's blink, and Yone takes more damage from Ahri.

counters.why_ar: توقف Charm اندفاع Justice Punch وتجعل Galio يمشي نحو Ahri.
counters.why_en: Charm stops Justice Punch's charge and makes Galio walk toward Ahri.

counters.why_ar: توقف Charm مهارات الحركة مثل Astral Flight، وتضربه Orb of Deception.
counters.why_en: Charm stops movement abilities like Astral Flight, and Orb of Deception pokes him.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Justice Punch بـ Akali خارج Shuriken Flip، ويستفزها Shield of Durand.
countered_by.why_en: Justice Punch knocks Akali up out of Shuriken Flip, and Shield of Durand taunts her.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Akali بـ Ring of Frost خارج Twilight Shroud، وتشلّها Frozen Tomb.
countered_by.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Akali out of Twilight Shroud, and Frozen Tomb stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Akali بـ The Hextech Ultimatum فتقطع هروبها بـ Shuriken Flip وPerfect Execution.
countered_by.why_en: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors Akali, cutting off Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution escapes.

counters.why_ar: يصعّب تخفّي Twilight Shroud تصويب Timewinder، وتُعدم Ekko بـ Perfect Execution منخفض الصحة.
counters.why_en: Twilight Shroud's invisibility makes Timewinder hard to aim, and Perfect Execution executes a low-health Ekko.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Twilight Shroud بطلَ Akali غير مرئية فلا يستهدفها Disintegrate، وتندفع Shuriken Flip نحو Annie.
counters.why_en: Twilight Shroud makes Akali invisible so Disintegrate cannot target her, and Shuriken Flip dives onto Annie.

counters.why_ar: يتيح تخفّي Twilight Shroud لـ Akali دخول Hallowed Mist دون أن تُرى، وتُعدم Gwen بـ Perfect Execution.
counters.why_en: Twilight Shroud's invisibility lets Akali enter Hallowed Mist unseen, and Perfect Execution executes Gwen.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall مقذوف Avengerang ورصاصات Comeuppance.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Avengerang and Comeuppance's Mist shots.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Akshan بـ Ring of Frost، ويشلّه Frozen Tomb.
countered_by.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Akshan, and Frozen Tomb stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade ضربات Akshan، وتندفع Lunar Rush نحوه.
countered_by.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield soaks Akshan's poke, and Lunar Rush dashes onto him.

counters.why_ar: يصل تمويه Going Rogue وHeroic Swing إلى Vel'Koz، ويتفوق Avengerang عليه.
counters.why_en: Going Rogue's camouflage and Heroic Swing reach Vel'Koz, and Avengerang out-pokes him.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Avengerang على Aurora في الضرب من بعيد، ويخفف درع Dirty Fighting انفجارها.
counters.why_en: Avengerang out-pokes Aurora, and Dirty Fighting's damage shield blunts her burst.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Avengerang اللانهائي تقريبًا على Ryze، ويتفادى Heroic Swing تجهيز Rune Prison.
counters.why_en: Avengerang's near-infinite range out-pokes Ryze, and Heroic Swing dodges Rune Prison's setup.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Howling Gale بـ Alistar في الهواء ويدفعه Monsoon للخلف قبل إصابة Headbutt.
countered_by.why_en: Howling Gale knocks Alistar up and Monsoon knocks him back before Headbutt can land.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield التعطيل الناتج عن Headbutt وPulverize.
countered_by.why_en: Black Shield absorbs the disabling effects of Headbutt and Pulverize.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Alistar بـ Equinox فتمنع Headbutt وPulverize، وتثبّته عند انتهائها.
countered_by.why_en: Equinox silences Alistar, stopping Headbutt and Pulverize, and roots him when it expires.

counters.why_ar: تزيل Unbreakable Will شلل Shattering Strike، ويتجاهل Trample تصادم الوحدات فيبقى على Rell.
counters.why_en: Unbreakable Will removes Shattering Strike's stun, and Trample ignores unit collision to stay on Rell.

counters.why_ar: تزيل Unbreakable Will تثبيت Grasping Roots، ويغلق Headbutt المسافة نحو Zyra.
counters.why_en: Unbreakable Will removes the root from Grasping Roots, and Headbutt closes the gap on Zyra.

counters.why_ar: يعاقب Headbutt وPulverize Blitzcrank بعد خطأ Rocket Grab، وتزيل Unbreakable Will إسكات Static Field.
counters.why_en: Headbutt and Pulverize punish Blitzcrank after a missed Rocket Grab, and Unbreakable Will removes Static Field's silence.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Ambessa بـ Ruthless Predator، ويغلق Slice and Dice المسافة نحوها.
countered_by.why_en: Ruthless Predator stuns Ambessa, and Slice and Dice closes on her.

countered_by.why_ar: يخفض Mocking Shout قوة هجوم Ambessa (AD)، وتصمد Undying Rage أمام اندفاعها.
countered_by.why_en: Mocking Shout lowers Ambessa's Attack Damage, and Undying Rage outlasts her burst.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Ambessa بـ Thundering Blow للخلف، وتضربها Shock Blast.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Blow knocks Ambessa back, and Shock Blast pokes her.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Lacerate ويلاحق Dr. Mundo بـ Drakehound's Step، ويمتص درع Repudiation مهارة Infected Bonesaw.
counters.why_en: Lacerate's slow and Drakehound's Step chase Dr. Mundo, and Repudiation's shield absorbs Infected Bonesaw.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Repudiation اندفاع Maokai، ويزيد الضرر الذي تصدّه من قوة ضربتها الأرضية.
counters.why_en: Repudiation's shield absorbs Maokai's burst, and the damage she blocks makes her slam hit harder.

counters.why_ar: تخضع Gnar بـ Public Execution وتشلّه بالضربة الأرضية، ويبطئه Lacerate.
counters.why_en: Public Execution suppresses Gnar and slams him with a stun, and Lacerate slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Bandage Toss فيبقى Amumu بلا بداية.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Bandage Toss, leaving Amumu without his engage.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Ragnarok بطلَ Olaf محصّنًا ضد التعطيل، ومنه شلل Bandage Toss وCurse of the Sad Mummy.
countered_by.why_en: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to disables, including Bandage Toss's stun and Curse of the Sad Mummy.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Amumu بـ Reap فتمنع Bandage Toss، ويبعده رعب Terrify.
countered_by.why_en: Reap's silence stops Bandage Toss, and Terrify's fear keeps Amumu away.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Warwick بـ Bandage Toss قبل Infinite Duress، وتستنزف Despair أقصى صحته كل ثانية.
counters.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Warwick before Infinite Duress, and Despair drains his max Health every second.

counters.why_ar: تمنع Xin Zhao بـ Curse of the Sad Mummy من الهجوم والحركة، وتستنزف Despair أقصى صحته.
counters.why_en: Curse of the Sad Mummy stops Xin Zhao from attacking or moving, and Despair drains his max Health.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Viego بـ Bandage Toss، وتجعله Curse of the Sad Mummy عاجزًا عن الهجوم والحركة.
counters.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Viego, and Curse of the Sad Mummy leaves him unable to attack or move.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى قفز Across the Veil الخفي مهارة Disintegrate، وتبطئ The Weirding ثم تعيد Aurora للخلف.
countered_by.why_en: Across the Veil's invisible leap dodges Disintegrate, and The Weirding slows then hops Aurora back.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade انفجار Annie، وتندفع Lunar Rush نحوها.
countered_by.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield soaks Annie's burst, and Lunar Rush dashes onto her.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Annie بـ Null Sphere، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري انفجارها.
countered_by.why_en: Null Sphere silences Annie, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs her burst.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Orianna بـ Pyromania، وتفجّرها قفزة Tibbers.
counters.why_en: Pyromania stuns Orianna, and Tibbers' pounce bursts her.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Ryze بـ Pyromania، ويفجّره مخروط Incinerate.
counters.why_en: Pyromania stuns Ryze, and Incinerate's cone bursts him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Galio بـ Pyromania أثناء الشحن، ويخفف Molten Shield ضرر Winds of War.
counters.why_en: Pyromania stuns Galio mid-charge, and Molten Shield blunts his Winds of War.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى تمويه Ambush تصويب Ashe، ويتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروعها.
countered_by.why_en: Ambush's camouflage dodges Ashe's aim, and Deadly Venom's true damage ignores her armor.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Ashe بـ Buster Shot للخلف، ويغلق إبطاء Rocket Jump المسافة.
countered_by.why_en: Buster Shot knocks Ashe back, and Rocket Jump's slow closes the gap.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Ashe بـ Nevermove ويسحبها، وتستنزفها Demonic Ascension.
countered_by.why_en: Nevermove roots and pulls Ashe in, and Demonic Ascension drains her.

counters.why_ar: تبطئ Caitlyn بـ Frost Shot وتشلّها Enchanted Crystal Arrow من مسافة بعيدة قبل نصب فخاخها.
counters.why_en: Frost Shot slows Caitlyn and Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns her from across the map before her traps are set.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Enchanted Crystal Arrow ويبطئ Xayah بـ Frost Shot بعد قفز Featherstorm.
counters.why_en: Enchanted Crystal Arrow's stun and Frost Shot's slow catch Xayah after her Featherstorm leap.

counters.why_ar: تتجاوز سهام Volley التسعة وإبطاء Frost Shot درع Spell Shield الذي يصدّ مهارة واحدة فقط.
counters.why_en: Volley's 9 arrows and Frost Shot's slow overwhelm Spell Shield, which blocks only one ability.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Aurelion Sol بـ Null Sphere فتوقف Breath of Light، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Null Sphere silences Aurelion Sol, stopping Breath of Light, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Falling Star، ويندفع Urchin Strike نحو Aurelion Sol.
countered_by.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, dodging Falling Star, and Urchin Strike dives onto Aurelion Sol.

countered_by.why_ar: يقفز Assassin's Path بـ Talon فوق التضاريس نحو Aurelion Sol، وينزف Blade's End صحته.
countered_by.why_en: Assassin's Path vaults Talon over terrain onto Aurelion Sol, and Blade's End bleeds him.

counters.why_ar: Breath of Light شعاع لا يصدّه Wind Wall، وتشلّ Yasuo بـ Falling Star.
counters.why_en: Breath of Light is a beam Wind Wall cannot block, and Falling Star stuns Yasuo.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Ryze بـ Singularity ويشلّه Falling Star فلا تصيب Rune Prison.
counters.why_en: Singularity pulls Ryze in and Falling Star stuns him, so Rune Prison never lands.

counters.why_ar: تشلّ Galio بـ Falling Star، وتسحبه Singularity.
counters.why_en: Falling Star stuns Galio, and Singularity pulls him in.

countered_by.why_ar: يقطع Doom 'N Gloom قفزة Across the Veil، ويصيب رعب Vex Aurora.
countered_by.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom interrupts Across the Veil's leap, and Vex's fear lands on Aurora.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Death Mark بطلَ Zed غير قابل للاستهداف أثناء الاندفاع نحو Aurora، وتضربها Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable as he dashes onto Aurora, and Razor Shuriken hits through his shadows.

countered_by.why_ar: يقلّل علاج Death Lotus المخفّض شفاء أرواح Aurora، ويغلق Shunpo المسافة نحوها.
countered_by.why_en: Death Lotus's healing reduction cuts Aurora's spirit healing, and Shunpo closes on her.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى قفز Across the Veil الخفي مهارة Disintegrate، وتبطئ The Weirding ثم تعيد Aurora للخلف.
counters.why_en: Across the Veil's invisible leap dodges Disintegrate, and The Weirding slows then hops Aurora back.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى قفز Across the Veil الخفي بطاقات Wild Cards، وتبطئه The Weirding.
counters.why_en: Across the Veil's invisible leap dodges Wild Cards, and The Weirding slows him.

counters.why_ar: يتجاوز تخفّي Across the Veil البرج، وتبطئه The Weirding قبل أن تقفز Aurora للخلف.
counters.why_en: Across the Veil's invisibility slips past the turret, and The Weirding slows him before she hops back.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Bard بـ Rocket Grab من موضعه وتطيح به Power Fist قبل وصول Cosmic Binding.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Bard out of position and Power Fist pops him up before Cosmic Binding lands.

countered_by.why_ar: تسلسل Bard بـ Death Sentence وتسحبه، ويدفعه Flay للخلف.
countered_by.why_en: Death Sentence chains and pulls Bard in, and Flay knocks him back.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Bard بـ Last Embrace، ويتفوق Relic Cannon عليه مدى.
countered_by.why_en: Last Embrace roots Bard, and Relic Cannon outranges him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Seraphine بـ Cosmic Binding وتضعها Tempered Fate في جمود قبل Beat Drop.
counters.why_en: Cosmic Binding stuns Seraphine and Tempered Fate puts her in stasis before Beat Drop.

counters.why_ar: تضع Milio بـ Tempered Fate وحامله في جمود وتشلّهما، ويبطئه Cosmic Binding.
counters.why_en: Tempered Fate puts Milio and his carry in stasis and stuns them, and Cosmic Binding slows him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Lux بـ Cosmic Binding عند الجدار، ويوقف جمود Tempered Fate مهارة Final Spark.
counters.why_en: Cosmic Binding stuns Lux against a wall, and Tempered Fate's stasis stops Final Spark.

countered_by.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable مهارة Rocket Grab ويدمّر الخطّاف على الدرع.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Rocket Grab, destroying the hook on his shield.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Blitzcrank بـ Dredge Line، ويحسم درع Titan's Wrath المبادلة.
countered_by.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Blitzcrank in, and Titan's Wrath's shield wins the trade.

countered_by.why_ar: يعاقب Headbutt وPulverize Blitzcrank بعد خطأ Rocket Grab، وتزيل Unbreakable Will إسكات Static Field.
countered_by.why_en: Headbutt and Pulverize punish Blitzcrank after a missed Rocket Grab, and Unbreakable Will removes Static Field's silence.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Milio بـ Rocket Grab بعيدًا عن حامله، وتُسكته Static Field.
counters.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Milio away from his carry, and Static Field silences him.

counters.why_ar: تمسك Rocket Grab بطلَ Sona الهشة وتُسكتها Static Field قبل جاهزية Power Chord.
counters.why_en: Rocket Grab catches fragile Sona and Static Field silences her before Power Chord is ready.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Bard بـ Rocket Grab من موضعه وتطيح به Power Fist قبل وصول Cosmic Binding.
counters.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Bard out of position and Power Fist pops him up before Cosmic Binding lands.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade ضرر Brand، وتغلق Lunar Rush المسافة.
countered_by.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield absorbs Brand's damage, and Lunar Rush closes the gap.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Tectonic Disruption بـ Brand، ويبطئه Plasma Fission.
countered_by.why_en: Tectonic Disruption knocks Brand up, and Plasma Fission slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Brand بـ Bone Skewer، وتُعدمه Death From Below عند انخفاض صحته.
countered_by.why_en: Bone Skewer pulls Brand in, and Death From Below executes him at low health.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Sear بطلَ Ziggs المشتعل بـ Blaze، وتعاقب Pillar of Flame ثباته أثناء الإلقاء.
counters.why_en: Sear stuns an ablaze Ziggs, and Pillar of Flame punishes his stand-still casting.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Sear بطلَ Swain المشتعل بـ Blaze قبل إصابة Nevermove، ويوسّع Conflagration الحرق.
counters.why_en: Sear stuns an ablaze Swain before Nevermove lands, and Conflagration spreads the burn.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Sear بطلَ Thresh المشتعل بـ Blaze، وتضربه Pyroclasm قبل إصابة Death Sentence.
counters.why_en: Sear stuns an ablaze Thresh, and Pyroclasm pokes him before Death Sentence lands.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Braum بـ Temporal Mirage ومقذوف Winter's Bite، فيبقى مكشوفًا لـ Time Bomb.
countered_by.why_en: Temporal Mirage slows Braum and his Winter's Bite, leaving him open to Time Bomb.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق Piercing Darkness على Braum مدى، وتثبّته Last Embrace.
countered_by.why_en: Piercing Darkness outreaches Braum, and Last Embrace roots him.

countered_by.why_ar: تطيح Grand Entrance بـ Braum وتسحره The Quickness، وليست أيٌّ منهما مقذوفًا يعترضه Unbreakable.
countered_by.why_en: Grand Entrance knocks Braum up and The Quickness charms him, and neither is a projectile Unbreakable can intercept.

counters.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable مهارة Rocket Grab ويدمّر الخطّاف على الدرع.
counters.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Rocket Grab, destroying the hook on his shield.

counters.why_ar: يلغي Unbreakable ضرر أول هجمة ويقلّل الباقي، فيضعف حليف Nami المعزّز بـ Tidecaller's Blessing.
counters.why_en: Unbreakable negates the first attack and reduces the rest, blunting the ally Nami empowers with Tidecaller's Blessing.

counters.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable مرساة Dredge Line، ويبطئ Nautilus بـ Winter's Bite.
counters.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Dredge Line's anchor, and Winter's Bite slows Nautilus.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Caitlyn بـ Frost Shot وتشلّها Enchanted Crystal Arrow من مسافة بعيدة قبل نصب فخاخها.
countered_by.why_en: Frost Shot slows Caitlyn and Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns her from across the map before her traps are set.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Caitlyn المعلّمة بـ Plasma بدرع حماية، وتضيف Supercharge التخفّي.
countered_by.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto a Plasma-marked Caitlyn with a shield, and Supercharge adds invisibility.

countered_by.why_ar: ينتقل Arcane Shift فوريًا خارج Yordle Snap Trap و90 Caliber Net، وتضرب Caitlyn بـ Mystic Shot.
countered_by.why_en: Arcane Shift teleports out of Yordle Snap Trap and 90 Caliber Net, and Mystic Shot pokes Caitlyn.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Piltover Peacemaker على Corki مدى، ويتيح ارتداد 90 Caliber Net لـ Caitlyn مراوغته.
counters.why_en: Piltover Peacemaker outranges Corki, and 90 Caliber Net's recoil lets Caitlyn kite him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Yordle Snap Trap حركة Zeri ويبطئها 90 Caliber Net فيوقفان مراوغة Spark Surge.
counters.why_en: Yordle Snap Trap immobilizes Zeri and 90 Caliber Net slows her, stopping her Spark Surge kiting.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Yordle Snap Trap حركة Tristana بعد هبوط Rocket Jump، ويتضاعف مدى Headshot على الأهداف المحاصرة.
counters.why_en: Yordle Snap Trap immobilizes Tristana after Rocket Jump lands, and Headshot's range doubles on trapped targets.

countered_by.why_ar: يستفز Camille بـ Shadow Dash، ويصدّ Spirit's Refuge هجماتها.
countered_by.why_en: Shadow Dash taunts Camille, and Spirit's Refuge blocks her attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تمنع Hallowed Mist استهداف The Hextech Ultimatum، ويسبب Snip Snip ضررًا حقيقيًا.
countered_by.why_en: Hallowed Mist blocks The Hextech Ultimatum's targeting, and Snip Snip deals true damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Camille بـ Thundering Smash عند أول هجمة، ويبطئها Sky Splitter.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Smash stuns Camille on his first attack, and Sky Splitter slows her.

counters.why_ar: يحمي Camille بـ Adaptive Defenses من نوع ضرر Garen، ويعالجها Tactical Sweep.
counters.why_en: Adaptive Defenses shields Camille from Garen's damage type, and Tactical Sweep heals her.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Hookshot بـ Riven، وتثبّتها The Hextech Ultimatum فلا تهرب اندفاعاتها.
counters.why_en: Hookshot knocks Riven up, and The Hextech Ultimatum anchors her so her dashes cannot escape.

counters.why_ar: تحاصر Hookshot وThe Hextech Ultimatum Kayle في القتال القريب، ويحمي Camille بـ Adaptive Defenses من نوع ضررها.
counters.why_en: Hookshot and The Hextech Ultimatum lock Kayle in melee, and Adaptive Defenses shields Camille from her damage type.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Way of the Hunter السحري تكديس دروع Cho'Gath، ويمتص درع Spirit Cleave انفجاره.
countered_by.why_en: Way of the Hunter's magic damage bypasses Cho'Gath's armor stacking, and Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs his burst.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases إطاحة Rupture، وتعالجه Maximum Dosage.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists Rupture's knock up, and Maximum Dosage heals him.

countered_by.why_ar: يذيب ضرر Thousand Cuts حسب الصحة وضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي Cho'Gath، وتحمي Hallowed Mist بطلة Gwen من Rupture ما دامت خارجها.
countered_by.why_en: A Thousand Cuts' health-based damage and Snip Snip's true damage melt Cho'Gath, and Hallowed Mist shields Gwen from Rupture while she is outside it.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Kennen بـ Feral Scream، ويطيح به Rupture ويبطئه.
counters.why_en: Feral Scream silences Kennen, and Rupture knocks him up and slows him.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Vladimir بـ Feral Scream فتوقف Sanguine Pool وTransfusion، ويتجاهل ضرر Feast الحقيقي تكديس صحته.
counters.why_en: Feral Scream silences Vladimir, stopping Sanguine Pool and Transfusion, and Feast's true damage ignores his health stacking.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Teemo بـ Rupture وتُسكته Feral Scream، ويُنهي ضرر Feast الحقيقي صحته المنخفضة.
counters.why_en: Rupture slows Teemo, Feral Scream silences him, and Feast's true damage executes his low health.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق Piltover Peacemaker على Corki مدى، ويتيح ارتداد 90 Caliber Net لـ Caitlyn مراوغته.
countered_by.why_en: Piltover Peacemaker outranges Corki, and 90 Caliber Net's recoil lets Caitlyn kite him.

countered_by.why_ar: يمزج Super Scorcher Breath ضررًا فيزيائيًا وسحريًا، وتُعدم شحناته من المستوى 3 Corki منخفض الصحة بضرر حقيقي.
countered_by.why_en: Super Scorcher Breath mixes physical and magic damage and its level 3 stacks execute low-health Corki with true damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Corki بـ Nevermove ويسحبه، وتستنزفه Demonic Ascension.
countered_by.why_en: Nevermove roots and pulls Corki in, and Demonic Ascension drains him.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Missile Barrage وPhosphorus Bomb Tristana قبل Rocket Jump، وتخفض Gatling Gun دروعها (Armor) ومقاومة سحرها (MR).
counters.why_en: Missile Barrage and Phosphorus Bomb poke Tristana before Rocket Jump, and Gatling Gun cuts her Armor and Magic Resist.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Phosphorus Bomb وMissile Barrage من بعيد، وتخفض Gatling Gun الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Nilah.
counters.why_en: Phosphorus Bomb and Missile Barrage poke from range, and Gatling Gun strips Nilah's Armor and Magic Resist.

counters.why_ar: تخفض Gatling Gun الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Zeri، وتكشفها Phosphorus Bomb عند عبور Spark Surge للجدران.
counters.why_en: Gatling Gun cuts Zeri's Armor and Magic Resist, and Phosphorus Bomb reveals her when Spark Surge vaults over terrain.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Infected Bonesaw من الصحة الحالية وعلاج Maximum Dosage على نزيف Hemorrhage.
countered_by.why_en: Infected Bonesaw's current-Health damage and Maximum Dosage's healing beat Hemorrhage's bleeds.

countered_by.why_ar: يندفع Skip 'N Slash بـ Gwen إلى داخل حافة Decimate، ويحسم ضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي مع علاج Thousand Cuts المواجهة الفردية.
countered_by.why_en: Skip 'N Slash dashes Gwen inside Decimate's blade edge, and Snip Snip's true damage with A Thousand Cuts' healing wins the 1v1.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Boomerang Throw وBoulder Toss Darius من بعيد وتبطئانه، ويبتعد Hop عن Apprehend.
countered_by.why_en: Boomerang Throw and Boulder Toss poke and slow Darius from range, and Hop kites away from Apprehend.

counters.why_ar: يُعدم ضرر Noxian Guillotine الحقيقي Garen متجاوزًا تقليل ضرر Courage.
counters.why_en: Noxian Guillotine's true damage executes Garen through Courage's damage reduction.

counters.why_ar: ينهك نزيف Hemorrhage المتراكم وتجاهل Apprehend للدروع (Armor) Poppy.
counters.why_en: Hemorrhage's stacking bleed and Apprehend's Armor ignore wear Poppy down.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Teemo بـ Apprehend، ويُنهيه ضرر Noxian Guillotine الحقيقي.
counters.why_en: Apprehend pulls Teemo in, and Noxian Guillotine's true damage finishes him.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Diana بـ Ring of Frost أثناء الانقضاض، وتشلّها Frozen Tomb.
countered_by.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Diana mid-dive, and Frozen Tomb stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: يستفز Diana بـ Shield of Durand أثناء الانقضاض، ويخفف درع Hero's Entrance السحري ضررها.
countered_by.why_en: Shield of Durand taunts Diana mid-dive, and Hero's Entrance's magic shield blunts her damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضرر Diana، وتُسكتها Null Sphere.
countered_by.why_en: Void Stone's magic shield absorbs Diana's damage, and Null Sphere silences her.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade انفجار Annie، وتندفع Lunar Rush نحوها.
counters.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield soaks Annie's burst, and Lunar Rush dashes onto her.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade ضرر Brand، وتغلق Lunar Rush المسافة.
counters.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield absorbs Brand's damage, and Lunar Rush closes the gap.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Pale Cascade ضربات Akshan، وتندفع Lunar Rush نحوه.
counters.why_en: Pale Cascade's shield soaks Akshan's poke, and Lunar Rush dashes onto him.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Thousand Cuts ضررًا حسب الصحة، وتمنع Hallowed Mist وصول Infected Bonesaw من الخارج.
countered_by.why_en: A Thousand Cuts deals health-based damage, and Hallowed Mist blocks Infected Bonesaw from outside.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Deathbringer Stance من أقصى الصحة وعلاج Umbral Dash على Dr. Mundo في الاستمرارية، وتثبّته Infernal Chains في مكانه.
countered_by.why_en: Deathbringer Stance's max-Health damage and Umbral Dash's healing out-sustain Dr. Mundo, and Infernal Chains pins him in place.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Dr. Mundo بـ Swirlseed، وتصيبه Lilting Lullaby بعد استهلاك Goes Where He Pleases.
countered_by.why_en: Swirlseed slows Dr. Mundo, and Lilting Lullaby's sleep lands after Goes Where He Pleases is used up.

counters.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases إطاحة Unstoppable Force، ويبطئه Infected Bonesaw.
counters.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists Unstoppable Force's knock up, and Infected Bonesaw slows him.

counters.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases أول شلّ للحركة، مثل تثبيت Fling داخل Mega Adhesive.
counters.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, like Fling's root in Mega Adhesive.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Shyvana بـ Infected Bonesaw، ويخزّن Heart Zapper ضررها ويعالج Dr. Mundo.
counters.why_en: Infected Bonesaw slows Shyvana, and Heart Zapper stores her damage and heals Dr. Mundo.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Featherstorm بطلَ Xayah غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Whirling Death، ويثبّت Draven بـ Bladecaller.
countered_by.why_en: Featherstorm makes Xayah untargetable, dodging Whirling Death, and Bladecaller roots Draven.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Draven بـ Make It Rain فلا يلاحق Spinning Axe، وتحسم سرعة هجوم Strut المبادلات.
countered_by.why_en: Make It Rain slows Draven so he cannot chase Spinning Axe, and Strut's attack speed wins trades.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl فؤوس Stand Aside، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Draven.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Stand Aside's axes, and Wild Rush closes on Draven.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Kalista بـ Stand Aside بعد اندفاع Martial Poise، وتحسم Spinning Axe المبادلة القصيرة.
counters.why_en: Stand Aside slows Kalista after a Martial Poise lunge, and Spinning Axe wins the short trade.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Stand Aside بـ Varus جانبًا فيقطع شحن Piercing Arrow الطويل.
counters.why_en: Stand Aside knocks Varus aside, interrupting the long charge of Piercing Arrow.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Stand Aside بـ Tristana جانبًا ويبطئها فيلغي بدايتها بـ Rocket Jump.
counters.why_en: Stand Aside knocks Tristana aside and slows her, cancelling her Rocket Jump engage.

countered_by.why_ar: يصعّب تخفّي Twilight Shroud تصويب Timewinder، وتُعدم Ekko بـ Perfect Execution منخفض الصحة.
countered_by.why_en: Twilight Shroud's invisibility makes Timewinder hard to aim, and Perfect Execution executes a low-health Ekko.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Justice Punch بـ Ekko، ويستفزه Shield of Durand.
countered_by.why_en: Justice Punch knocks Ekko up, and Shield of Durand taunts him.

countered_by.why_ar: تقفز Noxian Diplomacy نحو Ekko، ويبطئه Rake.
countered_by.why_en: Noxian Diplomacy leaps onto Ekko, and Rake slows him.

counters.why_ar: يتدحرج Phase Dive خارج مهارات Syndra وينتقل إليها، وتعيد Chronobreak الزمن بعد انفجارها.
counters.why_en: Phase Dive rolls out of Syndra's spells and teleports onto her, and Chronobreak rewinds her burst.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Chronobreak بطلَ Ekko غير قابل للاستهداف فتتفادى Primordial Burst.
counters.why_en: Chronobreak makes Ekko untargetable, dodging Primordial Burst.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Chronobreak بطلَ Ekko غير قابل للاستهداف وتعيد الزمن بعد انفجار Stormbringer، ويبطئ Volibear بـ Timewinder.
counters.why_en: Chronobreak makes Ekko untargetable and rewinds Stormbringer's burst, and Timewinder slows Volibear.

countered_by.why_ar: تكشف Evelynn بـ Thrill of the Hunt، ويبطئها Bola Strike ويكشفها.
countered_by.why_en: Thrill of the Hunt reveals Evelynn, and Bola Strike slows and reveals her.

countered_by.why_ar: يعاقب ضرر Denting Blows من أقصى الصحة وVault Breaker Evelynn قبل استخدامها Last Caress.
countered_by.why_en: Denting Blows' max-Health damage and Vault Breaker punish Evelynn before she can Last Caress.

countered_by.why_ar: يكشف Void Spike المطوَّر Evelynn ويبطئه فيكسر تمويه Demon Shade.
countered_by.why_en: Evolved Void Spike reveals and slows Evelynn, breaking her Demon Shade camouflage.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Last Caress بطلَ Evelynn غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Infinite Duress، وتبطئ Warwick بـ Allure أو تسحره.
counters.why_en: Last Caress makes Evelynn untargetable, dodging Infinite Duress, and Allure slows or charms Warwick.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Last Caress بطلَ Evelynn غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Collateral Damage، وتبطئ Graves بـ Allure أو تسحره.
counters.why_en: Last Caress makes Evelynn untargetable, dodging Collateral Damage, and Allure slows or charms Graves.

counters.why_ar: يمنع تمويه Demon Shade استهداف Bandage Toss لها، وتخفض Allure مقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Amumu.
counters.why_en: Demon Shade's camouflage stops Bandage Toss from targeting her, and Allure cuts Amumu's Magic Resist.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوفات Mystic Shot وEssence Flux فتبطل ضربات Ezreal من بعيد.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Mystic Shot and Essence Flux, shutting down his poke.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Mystic Shot، وتبطئ Ezreal بـ Rend.
countered_by.why_en: Martial Poise lunges dodge Mystic Shot, and Rend slows Ezreal.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Ezreal ويمتص درعها ضربات Mystic Shot.
countered_by.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto Ezreal and its shield soaks his Mystic Shot pokes.

counters.why_ar: ينتقل Arcane Shift فوريًا خارج Flame Chompers وZap!، وتضرب Jinx بـ Mystic Shot قبل تبديلها إلى Fishbones.
counters.why_en: Arcane Shift teleports out of Flame Chompers and Zap!, and Mystic Shot pokes Jinx before she swaps to Fishbones.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى Arcane Shift مهارتي Phosphorus Bomb وMissile Barrage، وتضرب Corki بـ Mystic Shot.
counters.why_en: Arcane Shift dodges Phosphorus Bomb and Missile Barrage, and Mystic Shot pokes Corki.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى Arcane Shift مهارة ACHOOO!، وتضرب Mystic Shot وEssence Flux Smolder قبل تجمّع شحنات Dragon Practice.
counters.why_en: Arcane Shift dodges ACHOOO!, and Mystic Shot and Essence Flux poke Smolder before Dragon Practice stacks build.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Dragon Strike بـ Fiddlesticks في الهواء، وتمنعه ساحة Cataclysm من الهرب.
countered_by.why_en: Dragon Strike knocks Fiddlesticks up, and Cataclysm's arena stops him fleeing.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Terrify، ويعاقب رعب Unspeakable Horror بطلَ Fiddlesticks.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Terrify, and Unspeakable Horror's fear punishes Fiddlesticks.

countered_by.why_ar: يكشف فخ Bushwhack بطلَ Fiddlesticks، وتضربه Javelin Toss من بعيد.
countered_by.why_en: Bushwhack's trap reveals Fiddlesticks, and Javelin Toss pokes him from range.

counters.why_ar: Bountiful Harvest وCrowstorm مهارات وليست هجمات عادية، فلا يعمل انعكاس Defensive Ball Curl.
counters.why_en: Bountiful Harvest and Crowstorm are abilities, so Defensive Ball Curl's reflect against basic attackers never triggers.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Amumu بـ Reap فتمنع Bandage Toss، ويبعده رعب Terrify.
counters.why_en: Reap's silence stops Bandage Toss, and Terrify's fear keeps Amumu away.

counters.why_ar: يصيب رعب Terrify بطلَ Kayn قبل Umbral Trespass، وتوقف إسكات Reap اندفاعاته.
counters.why_en: Terrify's fear lands before Umbral Trespass, and Reap's silence stops Kayn's dashes.

countered_by.why_ar: تخفف دروع Thunderclap وتقليل سرعة هجوم Ground Slam ضرر Fiora.
countered_by.why_en: Thunderclap's Armor and Ground Slam's attack speed cut blunt Fiora.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف Steadfast Presence اندفاع Lunge ويثبّت Fiora على الأرض.
countered_by.why_en: Steadfast Presence stops Lunge's dash and grounds Fiora.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات Fiora بلا ضرر فيبطل Bladework وتأثيرات Lunge عند الضربة.
countered_by.why_en: Blinding Dart makes Fiora's attacks deal no damage, voiding Bladework and Lunge's on-hit effects.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte ضرر The Darkin Blade ويشلّ Aatrox إن صدّ شلّ حركة.
counters.why_en: Riposte parries The Darkin Blade's damage and stuns Aatrox if it blocks an immobilizing effect.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte إبطاء Needlework وضرره ثم يبطئ Gwen.
counters.why_en: Riposte parries Needlework's slow and damage, then slows Gwen.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte إسكات Decisive Strike والضرر معه.
counters.why_en: Riposte parries Decisive Strike's silence and the damage with it.

countered_by.why_ar: يستفز Fizz بـ Shield of Durand، ويطيح به Justice Punch.
countered_by.why_en: Shield of Durand taunts Fizz, and Justice Punch knocks him up.

countered_by.why_ar: توقف Charm مهارات الحركة فورًا فيُقطع Urchin Strike وTrickster لدى Fizz.
countered_by.why_en: Charm instantly stops movement abilities, so Fizz's Urchin Strike and Trickster are cut off.

countered_by.why_ar: يقطع Doom 'N Gloom اندفاع Urchin Strike ويرعب Fizz.
countered_by.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom interrupts Urchin Strike's dash and fears Fizz.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف، ويبطئ Syndra بـ Chum the Waters ويطيح بها.
counters.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, and Chum the Waters slows and knocks Syndra up.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Pyroclasm، ويندفع Urchin Strike نحو Brand.
counters.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, dodging Pyroclasm, and Urchin Strike dives onto Brand.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Electro Harpoon، ويبطئ Rumble بـ Chum the Waters ويطيح به.
counters.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, dodging Electro Harpoon, and Chum the Waters slows and knocks Rumble up.

countered_by.why_ar: تستنزف Demonic Ascension صحة Galio، ويثبّته Nevermove بعد Justice Punch.
countered_by.why_en: Demonic Ascension drains Galio's Health, and Nevermove roots him after Justice Punch.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Galio بـ Scatter the Weak ويشلّه عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئه Force of Will.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Galio back and stuns him on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تشلّ Galio بـ Falling Star، وتسحبه Singularity.
countered_by.why_en: Falling Star stuns Galio, and Singularity pulls him in.

counters.why_ar: يستفز Katarina بـ Shield of Durand ويؤذيها، ويطيح بها Justice Punch.
counters.why_en: Shield of Durand taunts and damages Katarina, and Justice Punch knocks her up.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Justice Punch بـ Akali خارج Shuriken Flip، ويستفزها Shield of Durand.
counters.why_en: Justice Punch knocks Akali up out of Shuriken Flip, and Shield of Durand taunts her.

counters.why_ar: يستفز Diana بـ Shield of Durand أثناء الانقضاض، ويخفف درع Hero's Entrance السحري ضررها.
counters.why_en: Shield of Durand taunts Diana mid-dive, and Hero's Entrance's magic shield blunts her damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يحمي Camille بـ Adaptive Defenses من نوع ضرر Garen، ويعالجها Tactical Sweep.
countered_by.why_en: Adaptive Defenses shields Camille from Garen's damage type, and Tactical Sweep heals her.

countered_by.why_ar: تعزل Garen بـ Realm of Death وتسرق إحصاءاته، ويتفوق درع Indestructible في المبادلة الطويلة.
countered_by.why_en: Realm of Death isolates Garen and steals his stats, and Indestructible's shield beats his sustained trading.

countered_by.why_ar: يُعدم ضرر Noxian Guillotine الحقيقي Garen متجاوزًا تقليل ضرر Courage.
countered_by.why_en: Noxian Guillotine's true damage executes Garen through Courage's damage reduction.

counters.why_ar: يتحرر Decisive Strike من إبطاء Wither ويُسكت Nasus.
counters.why_en: Decisive Strike breaks free of Wither's slows and silences Nasus.

counters.why_ar: يقاوم Courage شلل Flawless Duet، ويُسكت Irelia بـ Decisive Strike.
counters.why_en: Courage resists Flawless Duet's stun, and Decisive Strike silences Irelia.

counters.why_ar: يقاوم Courage شلل Ki Burst، ويُسكت Riven بـ Decisive Strike.
counters.why_en: Courage resists Ki Burst's stun, and Decisive Strike silences Riven.

countered_by.why_ar: تطيح Unstoppable Force بـ Gnar، وتسرق Seismic Shard سرعة حركته.
countered_by.why_en: Unstoppable Force knocks Gnar up, and Seismic Shard steals his Movement Speed.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Gnar بـ Volcanic Rupture، وتطيح به Searing Charge.
countered_by.why_en: Volcanic Rupture slows Gnar, and Searing Charge knocks him up.

countered_by.why_ar: ينسحب Gnar ويُشلّ عند الشحنة الثانية من Ntofo Strikes، وتتجاهل مناعة Path Maker من الإزاحة دفعاته.
countered_by.why_en: Ntofo Strikes' second stack pulls and stuns Gnar, and Path Maker's displacement immunity ignores his knockbacks.

counters.why_ar: يبتعد Hop عن Slice and Dice، وتبطئ Renekton بـ Boomerang Throw أثناء الاقتراب.
counters.why_en: Hop kites away from Slice and Dice, and Boomerang Throw slows Renekton on approach.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Garen بـ Boomerang Throw وتبطئه، ويبتعد Hop عن Judgment.
counters.why_en: Boomerang Throw pokes and slows Garen, and Hop kites away from Judgment.

counters.why_ar: تراوغ Boomerang Throw وHop Nasus الذي يحتاج المدى القريب لتجميع Siphoning Strike.
counters.why_en: Boomerang Throw and Hop kite Nasus, who needs melee range to stack Siphoning Strike.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Gragas بـ Shield Vault، ويصدّ Aegis Assault مهارة Body Slam من الأمام.
countered_by.why_en: Shield Vault stuns Gragas, and Aegis Assault blocks Body Slam from the front.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Body Slam، ويسرّع مسار Duskbringer مطاردة Nocturne.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Body Slam, and Duskbringer's trail speeds Nocturne's chase.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Gragas بـ Thundering Shuriken، وتتفادى سرعة Lightning Rush مهارة Body Slam.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Shuriken pokes Gragas, and Lightning Rush's speed avoids Body Slam.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Kayn بـ Body Slam عند اندفاعه، ويدفعه Explosive Cask للخلف قبل Umbral Trespass.
counters.why_en: Body Slam stuns Kayn when he dashes in, and Explosive Cask knocks him back before Umbral Trespass.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Master Yi بـ Body Slam ويدفعه Explosive Cask للخلف، بينما تمنع Highlander الإبطاء فقط.
counters.why_en: Body Slam stuns Master Yi and Explosive Cask knocks him back; Highlander only blocks slows.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Rengar بـ Body Slam ويقطع كمينه، ويقلّل Drunken Rage الضرر الذي يتلقاه Gragas.
counters.why_en: Body Slam stuns Rengar out of his ambush, and Drunken Rage reduces the damage he deals.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Crescent Guard بطلَ Xin Zhao محصّنًا من ضرر الأبطال خارج الدائرة فتبطل مدى Graves.
countered_by.why_en: Crescent Guard makes Xin Zhao impervious to champion damage from outside the circle, nullifying Graves's range.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفوق Javelin Toss على Graves مدى، ويكشفه Bushwhack وسط Smoke Screen.
countered_by.why_en: Javelin Toss outranges Graves, and Bushwhack reveals him through Smoke Screen.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Graves بـ Reap فتمنع Quickdraw، ويجبره رعب Terrify على الهرب.
countered_by.why_en: Reap's silence stops Quickdraw, and Terrify's fear forces Graves away.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Smoke Screen سرعة Lillia المتراكمة، ويخفف درع Quickdraw الإضافي ضررها.
counters.why_en: Smoke Screen slows Lillia's speed stacks, and Quickdraw's Armor boost blunts her damage.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Kayn بـ Smoke Screen ويقلّص رؤيته، ويخفف درع Quickdraw الإضافي ضرر Reaping Slash.
counters.why_en: Smoke Screen slows Kayn and cuts his sight, and Quickdraw's Armor boost blunts Reaping Slash.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Amumu بـ Smoke Screen ويقلّص رؤيته، ويراوغه ارتداد Collateral Damage.
counters.why_en: Smoke Screen slows Amumu and cuts his sight, and Collateral Damage's recoil kites him.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte إبطاء Needlework وضرره ثم يبطئ Gwen.
countered_by.why_en: Riposte parries Needlework's slow and damage, then slows Gwen.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Gwen بـ Mega Adhesive ويثبّتها على الأرض، ويثبّتها Fling داخله.
countered_by.why_en: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds Gwen, and Fling roots her in it.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Gwen بـ Fate Sealed، ويمتص درع Spirit Cleave ضررها.
countered_by.why_en: Fate Sealed pulls Gwen in, and Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs her damage.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Thousand Cuts ضررًا حسب الصحة، وتمنع Hallowed Mist وصول Infected Bonesaw من الخارج.
counters.why_en: A Thousand Cuts deals health-based damage, and Hallowed Mist blocks Infected Bonesaw from outside.

counters.why_ar: تمنع Hallowed Mist استهداف The Hextech Ultimatum، ويسبب Snip Snip ضررًا حقيقيًا.
counters.why_en: Hallowed Mist blocks The Hextech Ultimatum's targeting, and Snip Snip deals true damage.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Hallowed Mist بطلَ Gwen غير قابلة للاستهداف من الخارج، ويتجاهل ضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي مقاومات Spirit of Dread.
counters.why_en: Hallowed Mist leaves Gwen untargetable from outside, and Snip Snip's true damage ignores Spirit of Dread's resistances.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Hecarim بـ Swirlseed وتنيمه Lilting Lullaby قبل وصوله إليها.
countered_by.why_en: Swirlseed slows Hecarim and Lilting Lullaby puts him to sleep before he reaches her.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Hecarim بـ Bandage Toss أثناء الاندفاع، وتجعله Curse of the Sad Mummy عاجزًا عن الهجوم والحركة.
countered_by.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Hecarim mid-charge, and Curse of the Sad Mummy leaves him unable to attack or move.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Hallowed Mist بطلَ Gwen غير قابلة للاستهداف من الخارج، ويتجاهل ضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي مقاومات Spirit of Dread.
countered_by.why_en: Hallowed Mist leaves Gwen untargetable from outside, and Snip Snip's true damage ignores Spirit of Dread's resistances.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Nidalee بـ Devastating Charge للخلف، وتجعلها موجة رعب Onslaught of Shadows تهرب.
counters.why_en: Devastating Charge's knockback lands on Nidalee, and Onslaught of Shadows' terror makes her flee.

counters.why_ar: يوقف دفع Devastating Charge كمين Rengar، وتجعله رعب Onslaught of Shadows يهرب.
counters.why_en: Devastating Charge's knockback stops Rengar's ambush, and Onslaught of Shadows' terror makes him flee.

counters.why_ar: يتجاوز دفع Devastating Charge ورعب Onslaught of Shadows صدّ Shroud of Darkness الواحد.
counters.why_en: Devastating Charge's knockback and Onslaught of Shadows' terror overwhelm Shroud of Darkness's single block.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall صواريخ Hextech Micro-Rockets وهي ضربة Heimerdinger الرئيسية.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Hextech Micro-Rockets, Heimerdinger's main poke.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز تخفّي Across the Veil البرج، وتبطئه The Weirding قبل أن تقفز Aurora للخلف.
countered_by.why_en: Across the Veil's invisibility slips past the turret, and The Weirding slows him before she hops back.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفوق Dark Sphere وUnleashed Power على Heimerdinger في الانفجار، ويشلّه Scatter the Weak.
countered_by.why_en: Dark Sphere and Unleashed Power out-burst Heimerdinger, and Scatter the Weak stuns him.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب نيران H-28 G Evolution Turret السريعة اندفاعات Bladesurge لدى Irelia، وتضربها Hextech Micro-Rockets.
counters.why_en: H-28 G Evolution Turret's rapid fire punishes Irelia's Bladesurge dives, and Micro-Rockets poke her.

counters.why_ar: يواصل H-28 G Evolution Turret الإطلاق أثناء اندفاع Fizz، وتضربه Hextech Micro-Rockets قبل Urchin Strike.
counters.why_en: H-28 G Evolution Turret keeps firing as Fizz dives, and Hextech Micro-Rockets poke him before Urchin Strike.

counters.why_ar: يحاصر H-28 G Evolution Turret وMicro-Rockets Kassadin قبل Riftwalk، ويعزّز Upgrade!!! المهارة التالية.
counters.why_en: H-28 G Evolution Turret and Micro-Rockets zone Kassadin before Riftwalk, and Upgrade!!! boosts the next spell.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Hwei بـ Fate Sealed، ويمتص درع Spirit Cleave ضرباته.
countered_by.why_en: Fate Sealed pulls Hwei in, and Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs his poke.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall مقذوف Devastating Fire.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Devastating Fire's projectile.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Hwei بـ Scatter the Weak عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئه Force of Will.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak stuns Hwei on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows him.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Severing Bolt Vex من بعيد، ويرعبها Grim Visage ويبطئها.
counters.why_en: Severing Bolt pokes Vex from long range, and Grim Visage fears and slows her.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Crushing Maw Sylas ويبطئه، وتضربه Severing Bolt من بعيد.
counters.why_en: Crushing Maw draws Sylas in and slows him, and Severing Bolt pokes from long range.

counters.why_ar: يرعب Grim Visage Swain ويبطئه، ويسحبه Crushing Maw.
counters.why_en: Grim Visage fears and slows Swain, and Crushing Maw pulls him in.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike كل هجمات Irelia وتشلّها.
countered_by.why_en: Counter Strike dodges all of Irelia's attacks and stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: يقلّل Ground Slam سرعة هجوم Irelia، وتطيح بها Unstoppable Force.
countered_by.why_en: Ground Slam cuts Irelia's attack speed, and Unstoppable Force knocks her up.

countered_by.why_ar: تعاقب نيران H-28 G Evolution Turret السريعة اندفاعات Bladesurge لدى Irelia، وتضربها Hextech Micro-Rockets.
countered_by.why_en: H-28 G Evolution Turret's rapid fire punishes Irelia's Bladesurge dives, and Micro-Rockets poke her.

counters.why_ar: تغلق Bladesurge المسافة نحو Syndra، ويشلّها Flawless Duet.
counters.why_en: Bladesurge closes on Syndra, and Flawless Duet stuns her.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Bladesurge نحو Teemo، ويشلّه Flawless Duet.
counters.why_en: Bladesurge dashes onto Teemo, and Flawless Duet stuns him.

counters.why_ar: تغلق Bladesurge المسافة نحو Gnar، ويشلّه Flawless Duet.
counters.why_en: Bladesurge closes on Gnar, and Flawless Duet stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Janna بـ Hymn of Valor، وتعالج Aria of Perseverance ضرر Zephyr.
countered_by.why_en: Hymn of Valor pokes Janna, and Aria of Perseverance heals through her Zephyr damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Janna بـ Rocket Grab قبل Howling Gale، وتُسكتها Static Field.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Janna in before Howling Gale, and Static Field silences her.

countered_by.why_ar: تسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل على Janna، وتسحرها Encore.
countered_by.why_en: Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun on Janna, and Encore charms her.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Howling Gale بـ Alistar في الهواء ويدفعه Monsoon للخلف قبل إصابة Headbutt.
counters.why_en: Howling Gale knocks Alistar up and Monsoon knocks him back before Headbutt can land.

counters.why_ar: يوقف دفع Monsoon وإطاحة Howling Gale وصول Leona إلى حاملها بـ Zenith Blade.
counters.why_en: Monsoon's knockback and Howling Gale's knock up stop Leona from reaching her carry with Zenith Blade.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Howling Gale بـ Zilean ويدفعه Monsoon للخلف قبل إصابة Time Bomb.
counters.why_en: Howling Gale knocks Zilean up and Monsoon knocks him back before Time Bomb lands.

countered_by.why_ar: تمنع Hallowed Mist استهداف Cataclysm، ويسبب Snip Snip ضررًا حقيقيًا.
countered_by.why_en: Hallowed Mist blocks Cataclysm's targeting, and Snip Snip deals true damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى اندفاع Alpha Strike غير القابل للاستهداف قفزة Cataclysm، وتتجاهل Highlander إبطاء Golden Aegis.
countered_by.why_en: Alpha Strike's untargetable dash dodges Cataclysm's leap, and Highlander shrugs off Golden Aegis's slow.

countered_by.why_ar: تخضع Jarvan IV بـ Infinite Duress قبل Cataclysm، ويتفوق تقليل ضرر Primal Howl على اندفاعه.
countered_by.why_en: Infinite Duress suppresses Jarvan IV before Cataclysm, and Primal Howl's damage reduction beats his burst.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Dragon Strike بـ Nidalee، وتمنع ساحة Cataclysm مراوغتها بـ Pounce.
counters.why_en: Dragon Strike's lunge knocks Nidalee up, and Cataclysm's arena stops her Pounce kiting.

counters.why_ar: تحاصر ساحة Cataclysm بطلَ Kayn، ويطيح به Dragon Strike.
counters.why_en: Cataclysm's terrain arena traps Kayn, and Dragon Strike knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Dragon Strike بـ Rengar، وتحاصره ساحة Cataclysm.
counters.why_en: Dragon Strike knocks Rengar up, and Cataclysm's arena traps him.

countered_by.why_ar: يقلّل Ground Slam سرعة هجوم Jax، وتخفف دروع Thunderclap ضرره الفيزيائي.
countered_by.why_en: Ground Slam cuts Jax's attack speed, and Thunderclap's Armor blunts his physical damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تصدّ حصانة Aegis Assault الأمامية هجمات Jax، ويشلّه Shield Vault.
countered_by.why_en: Aegis Assault's front invulnerability blocks Jax's attacks, and Shield Vault stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike الهجمات فقط، فتصيب Thundering Shuriken وMark of the Storm Jax.
countered_by.why_en: Counter Strike dodges only attacks, so Thundering Shuriken and Mark of the Storm still hit Jax.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike كل هجمات Irelia وتشلّها.
counters.why_en: Counter Strike dodges all of Irelia's attacks and stuns her.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike كل هجمات Ambessa القادمة وتشلّها.
counters.why_en: Counter Strike dodges all of Ambessa's incoming attacks and stuns her.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike كل هجمات Volibear وتشلّه.
counters.why_en: Counter Strike dodges all of Volibear's attacks and stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Jayce بـ Volcanic Rupture، وتطيح به Searing Charge رغم ضرباته.
countered_by.why_en: Volcanic Rupture slows Jayce, and Searing Charge knocks him up through his poke.

countered_by.why_ar: يُسكت Jayce بـ Decisive Strike، ويقلّل Courage ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Decisive Strike silences Jayce, and Courage reduces his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Jayce بـ Scatter the Weak خارج وضع المطرقة، ويبطئه Force of Will.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Jayce back out of Hammer Stance, and Force of Will slows him.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Shen بـ Shock Blast من بعيد، ويضيف Hyper Charge سرعة هجوم.
counters.why_en: Shock Blast pokes Shen from range, and Hyper Charge adds attack speed.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Ambessa بـ Thundering Blow للخلف، وتضربها Shock Blast.
counters.why_en: Thundering Blow knocks Ambessa back, and Shock Blast pokes her.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Shock Blast على Kassadin مدى، ويبطئه To the Skies!.
counters.why_en: Shock Blast outranges Kassadin, and To the Skies! slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوفات Dancing Grenade وDeadly Flourish، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Dancing Grenade and Deadly Flourish, and Wild Rush closes on a dashless Jhin.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Deadly Flourish، وتبطئ Rend بطلَ Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا.
countered_by.why_en: Martial Poise lunges dodge Deadly Flourish, and Rend slows Jhin, who has no dash.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا، ويمتص درعها ردّه.
countered_by.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto Jhin, who has no dash, and its shield soaks his return fire.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Kog'Maw بـ Deadly Flourish من مدى بعيد ويبطئه Captive Audience، وهو لا يملك اندفاعًا.
counters.why_en: Deadly Flourish roots Kog'Maw from extreme range and Captive Audience slows him; he has no dash.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Miss Fortune بـ Deadly Flourish، وتبعدها فخاخ Captive Audience عن Make It Rain.
counters.why_en: Deadly Flourish roots Miss Fortune, and Captive Audience's traps zone her out of Make It Rain.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Corki بـ Deadly Flourish من بعيد، ويبطئه فخ Captive Audience.
counters.why_en: Deadly Flourish roots Corki from long range, and Captive Audience's trap slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروع Jinx، ويبطئها Venom Cask.
countered_by.why_en: Deadly Venom's true damage ignores Jinx's armor, and Venom Cask slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: ينتقل Arcane Shift فوريًا خارج Flame Chompers وZap!، وتضرب Jinx بـ Mystic Shot قبل تبديلها إلى Fishbones.
countered_by.why_en: Arcane Shift teleports out of Flame Chompers and Zap!, and Mystic Shot pokes Jinx before she swaps to Fishbones.

countered_by.why_ar: لا تملك Jinx اندفاعًا، فإبطاء Frost Shot وشلل Enchanted Crystal Arrow يتيحان لـ Ashe الإمساك بها.
countered_by.why_en: Jinx has no dash, so Frost Shot's slow plus Enchanted Crystal Arrow's stun lets Ashe catch her.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Flame Chompers Samira في موضع هبوط Wild Rush، وتبطئها Zap! وتكشفها.
counters.why_en: Flame Chompers root Samira where Wild Rush lands, and Zap! slows and reveals her.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Flame Chompers Lucian في موضع هبوط Relentless Pursuit، وتبطئه Zap! وتكشفه.
counters.why_en: Flame Chompers root Lucian where Relentless Pursuit lands, and Zap! slows and reveals him.

counters.why_ar: تبطئ Tristana بـ Zap! وتثبّته Flame Chompers في موضع هبوط Rocket Jump.
counters.why_en: Zap! slows Tristana and Flame Chompers root her where Rocket Jump lands.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفوق سرعة الهجوم والضرر عند الضربة من Cultivation of Spirit على Icathian Rain لدى Kai'Sa.
countered_by.why_en: Cultivation of Spirit's attack speed and on-hit damage out-trade Kai'Sa's Icathian Rain.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوفات Icathian Rain وVoid Seeker.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Icathian Rain and Void Seeker's missiles.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Kai'Sa بـ Buster Shot بعد Killer Instinct، ويتفوق مدى Draw a Bead عليها.
countered_by.why_en: Buster Shot knocks Kai'Sa back after Killer Instinct, and Draw a Bead outranges her.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا، ويمتص درعها ردّه.
counters.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto Jhin, who has no dash, and its shield soaks his return fire.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Ezreal ويمتص درعها ضربات Mystic Shot.
counters.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto Ezreal and its shield soaks his Mystic Shot pokes.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Killer Instinct نحو Caitlyn المعلّمة بـ Plasma بدرع حماية، وتضيف Supercharge التخفّي.
counters.why_en: Killer Instinct dashes onto a Plasma-marked Caitlyn with a shield, and Supercharge adds invisibility.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl رمح Pierce، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Kalista.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Pierce's spear, and Wild Rush closes on Kalista.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Kalista بـ Stand Aside بعد اندفاع Martial Poise، وتحسم Spinning Axe المبادلة القصيرة.
countered_by.why_en: Stand Aside slows Kalista after a Martial Poise lunge, and Spinning Axe wins the short trade.

countered_by.why_ar: تعاقب منطقة إبطاء Make It Rain اندفاعات Martial Poise، وتسبب Bullet Time ضررًا كبيرًا لـ Kalista.
countered_by.why_en: Make It Rain's slow zone punishes Martial Poise lunges, and Bullet Time deals large damage to Kalista.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Deadly Flourish، وتبطئ Rend بطلَ Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا.
counters.why_en: Martial Poise lunges dodge Deadly Flourish, and Rend slows Jhin, who has no dash.

counters.why_ar: يلحق إبطاء Rend وضرره المتصاعد بـ Zeri، وتتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Burst Fire.
counters.why_en: Rend's slow and escalating damage catch Zeri, and Martial Poise lunges dodge Burst Fire.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Mystic Shot، وتبطئ Ezreal بـ Rend.
counters.why_en: Martial Poise lunges dodge Mystic Shot, and Rend slows Ezreal.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Karma بـ Rocket Grab، وتُسكتها Static Field قبل جاهزية Mantra.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Karma in, and Static Field silences her before Mantra is ready.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Karma بـ Dredge Line، ويثبّتها Staggering Blow لحظة.
countered_by.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Karma in, and Staggering Blow roots her briefly.

countered_by.why_ar: تشلّ Karma بـ Falling Star، وتسحبها Singularity من موضعها.
countered_by.why_en: Falling Star stuns Karma, and Singularity pulls her out of position.

counters.why_ar: تمنح Inspire سرعة حركة لحليف Karma لتفادي Dark Binding، بينما تضرب Morgana بـ Inner Flame أولًا.
counters.why_en: Inspire's Move Speed lets Karma's ally dodge Dark Binding, while Inner Flame pokes Morgana first.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Lux بـ Focused Resolve ما لم تكسر الرابط، ويمتص درع Inspire ضررها.
counters.why_en: Focused Resolve roots Lux unless she breaks the tether, and Inspire's shield absorbs her damage.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Zilean بـ Focused Resolve ما لم يكسر الرابط، ثم تتبعها Inner Flame.
counters.why_en: Focused Resolve roots Zilean unless he breaks the tether, and Inner Flame follows up.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Zed الفيزيائي درع Void Stone السحري، وتلاحق Kassadin بـ Death Mark بعد Riftwalk.
countered_by.why_en: Zed's physical damage ignores Void Stone's magic shield, and Death Mark follows Kassadin's Riftwalk.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Talon الفيزيائي درع Void Stone السحري، ويبطئ Kassadin بـ Rake.
countered_by.why_en: Talon's physical damage ignores Void Stone's magic shield, and Rake slows Kassadin.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Kassadin بـ Satchel Charge بعيدًا، وتبطئ Hexplosive Minefield تتمة Riftwalk.
countered_by.why_en: Satchel Charge knocks Kassadin away, and Hexplosive Minefield slows his Riftwalk follow-up.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Aurelion Sol بـ Null Sphere فتوقف Breath of Light، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضرره.
counters.why_en: Null Sphere silences Aurelion Sol, stopping Breath of Light, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs his damage.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Annie بـ Null Sphere، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري انفجارها.
counters.why_en: Null Sphere silences Annie, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs her burst.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضرر Diana، وتُسكتها Null Sphere.
counters.why_en: Void Stone's magic shield absorbs Diana's damage, and Null Sphere silences her.

countered_by.why_ar: يستفز Katarina بـ Shield of Durand ويؤذيها، ويطيح بها Justice Punch.
countered_by.why_en: Shield of Durand taunts and damages Katarina, and Justice Punch knocks her up.

countered_by.why_ar: يرعب Katarina بـ Doom 'N Gloom، ويمتص درع Personal Space مهارة Death Lotus.
countered_by.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom fears Katarina, and Personal Space's shield absorbs Death Lotus.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Frozen Tomb على نفسها Lissandra محصّنة من Death Lotus، ويثبّت Katarina بـ Ring of Frost.
countered_by.why_en: Frozen Tomb on herself makes Lissandra invulnerable to Death Lotus, and Ring of Frost roots Katarina.

counters.why_ar: يغلق Shunpo المسافة نحو Norra، وتطبّق Death Lotus تقليل العلاج.
counters.why_en: Shunpo closes on Norra, and Death Lotus applies healing reduction.

counters.why_ar: ينتقل Shunpo فوريًا إلى Syndra، وتمزّقها Death Lotus.
counters.why_en: Shunpo blinks onto Syndra, and Death Lotus shreds her.

counters.why_ar: يقلّل علاج Death Lotus المخفّض شفاء أرواح Aurora، ويغلق Shunpo المسافة نحوها.
counters.why_en: Death Lotus's healing reduction cuts Aurora's spirit healing, and Shunpo closes on her.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Kayle بـ Scatter the Weak للخلف، ويبطئ Force of Will اقترابها.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Kayle back, and Force of Will slows her approach.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Kayle بـ Shield Vault، ويصدّ Aegis Assault مهارة Radiant Blast القادمة من الأمام.
countered_by.why_en: Shield Vault stuns Kayle, and Aegis Assault blocks her Radiant Blast from the front.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Kayle بـ Null Sphere، وتنتقل Riftwalk فوريًا نحوها.
countered_by.why_en: Null Sphere silences Kayle, and Riftwalk blinks onto her.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Garen بـ Radiant Blast ويخفض مقاومته، ويراوغه مدى Divine Ascent.
counters.why_en: Radiant Blast slows Garen and reduces his resistances, and Divine Ascent's range kites him.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Divine Ascent على Singed، ويبطئه Radiant Blast.
counters.why_en: Divine Ascent's range outreaches Singed, and Radiant Blast slows him.

counters.why_ar: تخفض Radiant Blast مقاومة Aurelion Sol وتبطئه، وتعزّز Divine Ascent هجماتها.
counters.why_en: Radiant Blast cuts Aurelion Sol's resistances and slows him, and Divine Ascent scales her attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تحاصر ساحة Cataclysm بطلَ Kayn، ويطيح به Dragon Strike.
countered_by.why_en: Cataclysm's terrain arena traps Kayn, and Dragon Strike knocks him up.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Kayn بـ Frenzying Taunt على مهاجمة Rammus، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Kayn to attack Rammus, and Defensive Ball Curl returns the damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يصيب رعب Terrify بطلَ Kayn قبل Umbral Trespass، وتوقف إسكات Reap اندفاعاته.
countered_by.why_en: Terrify's fear lands before Umbral Trespass, and Reap's silence stops Kayn's dashes.

counters.why_ar: يعبر Shadow Step الجدران للحاق بـ Lillia، ويبطئ Blade's Reach سرعتها المتراكمة.
counters.why_en: Shadow Step walks through terrain to catch Lillia, and Blade's Reach slows her stacked speed.

counters.why_ar: يراوغ Reaping Slash وBlade's Reach Skarner، وتفجّره Umbral Trespass.
counters.why_en: Reaping Slash and Blade's Reach kite Skarner, and Umbral Trespass bursts him.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Amumu بـ Blade's Reach، ويمشي Shadow Step عبر الجدران بعيدًا عن Bandage Toss.
counters.why_en: Blade's Reach slows Amumu, and Shadow Step walks through terrain away from Bandage Toss.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Kennen بـ Feral Scream، ويطيح به Rupture ويبطئه.
countered_by.why_en: Feral Scream silences Kennen, and Rupture knocks him up and slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases أول شلل من Mark of the Storm.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first stun from Mark of the Storm.

countered_by.why_ar: تقلّص مقاومة السحر الإضافية من Living Forge ضرر Kennen، وتطيح به Searing Charge.
countered_by.why_en: Living Forge's bonus Magic Resistance shrinks Kennen's damage, and Searing Charge knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Teemo بـ Thundering Shuriken، ويشلّه Mark of the Storm بعد 3 إصابات.
counters.why_en: Thundering Shuriken pokes Teemo, and Mark of the Storm stuns him after 3 hits.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Counter Strike الهجمات فقط، فتصيب Thundering Shuriken وMark of the Storm Jax.
counters.why_en: Counter Strike dodges only attacks, so Thundering Shuriken and Mark of the Storm still hit Jax.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Singed بـ Thundering Shuriken، وتتفوق سرعة Lightning Rush على Poison Trail.
counters.why_en: Thundering Shuriken pokes Singed, and Lightning Rush's speed outruns his Poison Trail.

countered_by.why_ar: تقلّص Paranoia رؤية Kha'Zix ويصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Leap.
countered_by.why_en: Paranoia cuts Kha'Zix's sight and Shroud of Darkness blocks Leap.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Kha'Zix بـ Rake، ويفجّره Noxian Diplomacy عند عزله.
countered_by.why_en: Rake slows Kha'Zix, and Noxian Diplomacy bursts him when isolated.

countered_by.why_ar: يجرّ Kha'Zix بـ Frenzying Taunt إلى هجوم متهور، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt pulls Kha'Zix into a reckless assault, and Defensive Ball Curl returns damage.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Taste Their Fear ضررًا إضافيًا لـ Master Yi المعزول، ويلاحقه Leap.
counters.why_en: Taste Their Fear deals bonus damage to an isolated Master Yi, and Leap chases him.

counters.why_ar: يكشف Void Spike المطوَّر Evelynn ويبطئه فيكسر تمويه Demon Shade.
counters.why_en: Evolved Void Spike reveals and slows Evelynn, breaking her Demon Shade camouflage.

counters.why_ar: يعاقب Taste Their Fear بطلَ Viego المعزول، ويمهّد خفاء Void Assault للقتل.
counters.why_en: Taste Their Fear punishes an isolated Viego, and Void Assault's invisibility sets up the kill.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Kindred بـ Frenzying Taunt على مهاجمة Rammus، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إلى هجماتها.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Kindred to attack Rammus, and Defensive Ball Curl returns damage to her on-hit attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تمسك Allure السحرية وWhiplash Kindred، ويمهّد تمويه Demon Shade للقتل.
countered_by.why_en: Allure's charm and Whiplash catch Kindred, and Demon Shade's camouflage sets up the kill.

countered_by.why_ar: تلاحق Kindred بـ Cease and Desist، ويدفعها Vault Breaker للخلف.
countered_by.why_en: Cease and Desist runs Kindred down, and Vault Breaker knocks her back.

counters.why_ar: يراوغ Dance of Arrows وإبطاء Mounting Dread بطلَ Olaf، وتبقي Kindred بـ Lamb's Respite حيّة أمام اندفاعه.
counters.why_en: Dance of Arrows and Mounting Dread's slow kite Olaf, and Lamb's Respite keeps Kindred alive through his burst.

counters.why_ar: تمنع Lamb's Respite قتل Bountiful Harvest وCrowstorm، ويراوغه Dance of Arrows.
counters.why_en: Lamb's Respite stops Bountiful Harvest's execute and Crowstorm from killing, and Dance of Arrows kites him.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Warwick بـ Mounting Dread، ويبعده Dance of Arrows عن مدى Bloodhunt.
counters.why_en: Mounting Dread slows Warwick, and Dance of Arrows kites him away from Bloodhunt range.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Kog'Maw بـ Deadly Flourish من مدى بعيد ويبطئه Captive Audience، وهو لا يملك اندفاعًا.
countered_by.why_en: Deadly Flourish roots Kog'Maw from extreme range and Captive Audience slows him; he has no dash.

countered_by.why_ar: يباغت تمويه Ambush بطلَ Kog'Maw الذي لا يملك حركة، ويتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروعه.
countered_by.why_en: Ambush's camouflage ambushes Kog'Maw, who has no mobility, and Deadly Venom's true damage ignores his armor.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Yordle Snap Trap حركة Kog'Maw الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا، ويتضاعف مدى Headshot على المحاصرين.
countered_by.why_en: Yordle Snap Trap immobilizes Kog'Maw, who has no dash, and Headshot's range doubles on trapped targets.

counters.why_ar: تخفض Caustic Spittle الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Tristana، وتضرب Bio-Arcane Barrage من أقصى صحتها.
counters.why_en: Caustic Spittle shreds Tristana's Armor and Magic Resist, and Bio-Arcane Barrage deals max-health damage.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Bio-Arcane Barrage على Lucian مدى، وتخفض Caustic Spittle دروعه (Armor) ومقاومة سحره (MR).
counters.why_en: Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges Lucian, and Caustic Spittle shreds his Armor and Magic Resist.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Bio-Arcane Barrage على Formless Blade، ويبطئ Void Ooze اقتراب Nilah.
counters.why_en: Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges Formless Blade, and Void Ooze slows Nilah's approach.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Riposte شلل وسحب Ntofo Strikes ويشلّ K'Sante بالمقابل.
countered_by.why_en: Riposte parries Ntofo Strikes' stun-and-pull and stuns K'Sante in return.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Way of the Hunter السحري تكديس دروع K'Sante.
countered_by.why_en: Way of the Hunter's magic damage bypasses K'Sante's armor stacking.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات K'Sante بلا ضرر، ويراوغه Move Quick.
countered_by.why_en: Blinding Dart makes K'Sante's attacks deal no damage, and Move Quick kites him.

counters.why_ar: ينسحب Gnar ويُشلّ عند الشحنة الثانية من Ntofo Strikes، وتتجاهل مناعة Path Maker من الإزاحة دفعاته.
counters.why_en: Ntofo Strikes' second stack pulls and stuns Gnar, and Path Maker's displacement immunity ignores his knockbacks.

counters.why_ar: تمنع مناعة Path Maker من الإزاحة Death's Grasp من سحب K'Sante.
counters.why_en: Path Maker's displacement immunity stops Death's Grasp from pulling K'Sante.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Nasus بـ Ntofo Strikes ويشلّه، ويخفف درع Footwork ضرر Siphoning Strike.
counters.why_en: Ntofo Strikes slows and stuns Nasus, and Footwork's shield blunts his Siphoning Strike.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Lee Sin بـ Frenzying Taunt على الهجوم، ويبطئه Powerball.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Lee Sin to attack, and Powerball slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Lee Sin بـ Bandage Toss أثناء الاندفاع، وتجعله Curse of the Sad Mummy عاجزًا عن الهجوم والحركة.
countered_by.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Lee Sin mid-dash, and Curse of the Sad Mummy leaves him unable to attack or move.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف رعب Terrify وإسكات Reap مهارة Resonating Strike قبل بدايتها.
countered_by.why_en: Terrify's fear and Reap's silence stop Resonating Strike from starting.

counters.why_ar: تكشف Evelynn بـ Tempest وتبطئه Cripple فينتهي تمويه Demon Shade.
counters.why_en: Tempest reveals Evelynn and Cripple slows her, ending her Demon Shade camouflage.

counters.why_ar: تكشف Talon بـ Tempest خارج Shadow Assault، وتندفع Resonating Strike نحوه.
counters.why_en: Tempest reveals Talon out of Shadow Assault, and Resonating Strike dashes onto him.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Resonating Strike إلى Nidalee بعد Sonic Wave، وتكشفها Tempest.
counters.why_en: Resonating Strike dashes onto Nidalee after Sonic Wave, and Tempest reveals her.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف دفع Monsoon وإطاحة Howling Gale وصول Leona إلى حاملها بـ Zenith Blade.
countered_by.why_en: Monsoon's knockback and Howling Gale's knock up stop Leona from reaching her carry with Zenith Blade.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield شلل Shield of Daybreak وتثبيت Zenith Blade.
countered_by.why_en: Black Shield absorbs Shield of Daybreak's stun and Zenith Blade's root.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Leona بـ Equinox فتمنع Zenith Blade وEclipse، وتثبّتها عند انتهائها.
countered_by.why_en: Equinox silences Leona, stopping Zenith Blade and Eclipse, and roots her when it expires.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Nautilus بـ Zenith Blade ويشلّه Shield of Daybreak، وتبقي Leona بـ Eclipse حيّة أمام Dredge Line.
counters.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Nautilus, Shield of Daybreak stuns him, and Eclipse keeps Leona alive through Dredge Line.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Sona بـ Zenith Blade، وتمنح Eclipse الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لتتحمل Leona ضرباتها.
counters.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Sona, and Eclipse's Armor and Magic Resist let Leona survive her pokes.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Lulu بـ Zenith Blade ويشلّها Shield of Daybreak قبل Whimsy.
counters.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Lulu and Shield of Daybreak stuns her before Whimsy.

countered_by.why_ar: يعبر Shadow Step الجدران للحاق بـ Lillia، ويبطئ Blade's Reach سرعتها المتراكمة.
countered_by.why_en: Shadow Step walks through terrain to catch Lillia, and Blade's Reach slows her stacked speed.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Lillia بـ Vault Breaker للخلف، وتلاحقها Cease and Desist.
countered_by.why_en: Vault Breaker knocks Lillia back, and Cease and Desist runs her down.

countered_by.why_ar: تتجاهل Highlander إبطاء Swirlseed، ويتفادى اندفاع Alpha Strike غير القابل للاستهداف انفجارها.
countered_by.why_en: Highlander ignores Swirlseed's slow, and Alpha Strike's untargetable dash dodges her burst.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Hecarim بـ Swirlseed وتنيمه Lilting Lullaby قبل وصوله إليها.
counters.why_en: Swirlseed slows Hecarim and Lilting Lullaby puts him to sleep before he reaches her.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Wukong بـ Swirlseed وتنيمه Lilting Lullaby قبل Cyclone.
counters.why_en: Swirlseed slows Wukong and Lilting Lullaby puts him to sleep before Cyclone.

counters.why_ar: يراوغ إبطاء Swirlseed وسرعة Blooming Blows بطلَ Olaf قبل Ragnarok، وتضرب Watch Out! Eep! بقوة في المركز.
counters.why_en: Swirlseed's slow and Blooming Blows' speed kite Olaf before Ragnarok, and Watch Out! Eep! hits hard in the center.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Sanguine Pool بطلَ Vladimir غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Frozen Tomb ويسحب حياة Lissandra.
countered_by.why_en: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable, dodging Frozen Tomb, and siphons Lissandra's life.

countered_by.why_ar: تنيم Lissandra بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble قبل Frozen Tomb، وتضربها Paddle Star.
countered_by.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Lissandra to sleep before Frozen Tomb, and Paddle Star pokes her.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Lissandra بـ Nevermove قبل Ring of Frost، وتستنزفها Demonic Ascension.
countered_by.why_en: Nevermove roots Lissandra before Ring of Frost, and Demonic Ascension drains her.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Akshan بـ Ring of Frost، ويشلّه Frozen Tomb.
counters.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Akshan, and Frozen Tomb stuns him.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Diana بـ Ring of Frost أثناء الانقضاض، وتشلّها Frozen Tomb.
counters.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Diana mid-dive, and Frozen Tomb stuns her.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Yone بـ Ring of Frost، وتشلّه Frozen Tomb.
counters.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Yone, and Frozen Tomb stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Flame Chompers Lucian في موضع هبوط Relentless Pursuit، وتبطئه Zap! وتكشفه.
countered_by.why_en: Flame Chompers root Lucian where Relentless Pursuit lands, and Zap! slows and reveals him.

countered_by.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوف Ardent Blaze، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Lucian.
countered_by.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Ardent Blaze's missile, and Wild Rush closes on Lucian.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Lucian بـ Satchel Charge بعيدًا، وتبطئه Hexplosive Minefield.
countered_by.why_en: Satchel Charge knocks Lucian away, and Hexplosive Minefield slows him.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Relentless Pursuit مهارة Boomerang Blade، وتتجاوز ضربات Lightslinger المزدوجة درع Spell Shield.
counters.why_en: Relentless Pursuit dodges Boomerang Blade, and Lightslinger double-shots overwhelm Spell Shield.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب ضربات Lightslinger المزدوجة Smolder قبل أن تكبر شحنات Dragon Practice.
counters.why_en: Lightslinger double-shots punish Smolder before his Dragon Practice stacks scale.

counters.why_ar: تعلّم Zeri بـ Ardent Blaze وتكشفه، وتتفوق ضربات Lightslinger المزدوجة على Burst Fire.
counters.why_en: Ardent Blaze marks and reveals Zeri, and Lightslinger double-shots out-trade Burst Fire.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Lulu بـ Rocket Grab، ويوقف إسكات Static Field مهارة Whimsy.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Lulu in, and Static Field's silence stops Whimsy.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Lulu بـ Zenith Blade ويشلّها Shield of Daybreak قبل Whimsy.
countered_by.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Lulu and Shield of Daybreak stuns her before Whimsy.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Lulu بـ Last Embrace، ويتفوق Piercing Darkness عليها مدى.
countered_by.why_en: Last Embrace roots Lulu, and Piercing Darkness outranges her.

counters.why_ar: تمنع Pyke بـ Whimsy من استخدام Bone Skewer وPhantom Undertow، وتبطئه Glitterlance.
counters.why_en: Whimsy stops Pyke from casting Bone Skewer or Phantom Undertow, and Glitterlance slows him.

counters.why_ar: تمنع Zyra بـ Whimsy من استخدام Grasping Roots، وتبطئها Glitterlance.
counters.why_en: Whimsy stops Zyra from casting Grasping Roots, and Glitterlance slows her.

counters.why_ar: تحوّل Yuumi بـ Whimsy إلى مخلوق لا يهاجم ولا يستخدم المهارات، وتبطئها Glitterlance بشدة.
counters.why_en: Whimsy turns Yuumi into a critter that cannot attack or cast, and Glitterlance slows her heavily.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Light Binding عن الحلفاء، ويدفع Lux بـ Ultra Mega Fire Kick للخلف.
countered_by.why_en: Breath of Life removes Light Binding's root from allies, and Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks Lux back.

countered_by.why_ar: تمسك Rocket Grab بطلَ Lux الهشة، وتطيح بها Power Fist.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab catches fragile Lux, and Power Fist pops her up.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Lux بـ Focused Resolve ما لم تكسر الرابط، ويمتص درع Inspire ضررها.
countered_by.why_en: Focused Resolve roots Lux unless she breaks the tether, and Inspire's shield absorbs her damage.

counters.why_ar: تقيّد Rakan بـ Light Binding بعد Grand Entrance، وتبطئه Lucent Singularity.
counters.why_en: Light Binding binds Rakan after Grand Entrance, and Lucent Singularity slows him.

counters.why_ar: تقيّد Vladimir بـ Light Binding قبل Sanguine Pool، وتبطئه Lucent Singularity.
counters.why_en: Light Binding binds Vladimir before Sanguine Pool, and Lucent Singularity slows him.

counters.why_ar: تقيّد Senna بـ Light Binding، وتسبب Final Spark ضررًا كبيرًا من بعيد.
counters.why_en: Light Binding binds Senna, and Final Spark deals heavy damage from range.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases إطاحة Unstoppable Force، ويبطئه Infected Bonesaw.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists Unstoppable Force's knock up, and Infected Bonesaw slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي دروع Malphite المتراكمة.
countered_by.why_en: Snip Snip's true damage ignores Malphite's stacked Armor.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Sanguine Pool بطلَ Vladimir غير قابل للاستهداف ويبطئ Malphite، ويتفوق امتصاص Transfusion عليه.
countered_by.why_en: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable and slows Malphite, and Transfusion's life steal out-sustains him.

counters.why_ar: تخفف دروع Thunderclap وتقليل سرعة هجوم Ground Slam ضرر Fiora.
counters.why_en: Thunderclap's Armor and Ground Slam's attack speed cut blunt Fiora.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Unstoppable Force بـ Gnar، وتسرق Seismic Shard سرعة حركته.
counters.why_en: Unstoppable Force knocks Gnar up, and Seismic Shard steals his Movement Speed.

counters.why_ar: يقلّل Ground Slam سرعة هجوم Irelia، وتطيح بها Unstoppable Force.
counters.why_en: Ground Slam cuts Irelia's attack speed, and Unstoppable Force knocks her up.

countered_by.why_ar: يضيف Stand Behind Me دروعًا (Armor) ومقاومة سحر (MR) ضد ضرر Maokai السحري، ويلغي Unbreakable أول هجمة.
countered_by.why_en: Stand Behind Me adds Armor and Magic Resist against Maokai's magic damage, and Unbreakable negates the first attack.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Repudiation اندفاع Maokai، ويزيد الضرر الذي تصدّه من قوة ضربتها الأرضية.
countered_by.why_en: Repudiation's shield absorbs Maokai's burst, and the damage she blocks makes her slam hit harder.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف رعب Terrify وإسكات Reap مهارتي Twisted Advance وNature's Grasp قبل بدايتهما.
countered_by.why_en: Terrify's fear and Reap's silence stop Twisted Advance and Nature's Grasp before they start.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Pyke بـ Twisted Advance، ويدفعه Bramble Smash للخلف ويبطئه.
counters.why_en: Twisted Advance roots Pyke, and Bramble Smash knocks him back and slows him.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Zilean بـ Twisted Advance، ويثبّته جدار Nature's Grasp مجددًا.
counters.why_en: Twisted Advance roots Zilean, and Nature's Grasp's wall roots him again.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت اندفاع Twisted Advance غير القابل للاستهداف Karma، ويدفعها Bramble Smash للخلف.
counters.why_en: Twisted Advance's untargetable dash roots Karma, and Bramble Smash knocks her back.
