countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Master Yi بـ Frenzying Taunt على الهجوم، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Master Yi to attack, and Defensive Ball Curl returns his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Taste Their Fear ضررًا إضافيًا لـ Master Yi المعزول، ويلاحقه Leap.
countered_by.why_en: Taste Their Fear deals bonus damage to an isolated Master Yi, and Leap chases him.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Curse of the Sad Mummy بطلَ Master Yi عاجزًا عن الهجوم والحركة، بينما تمنع Highlander الإبطاء فقط.
countered_by.why_en: Curse of the Sad Mummy leaves Master Yi unable to attack or move, and Highlander only stops slows.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Highlander بطلَ Master Yi محصّنًا ضد إبطاء Undertow، ويُنهك Olaf بـ Wuju Style بضرر حقيقي.
counters.why_en: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to Undertow's slow, and Wuju Style's true damage wears Olaf down.

counters.why_ar: تتجاهل Highlander إبطاء Swirlseed، ويتفادى اندفاع Alpha Strike غير القابل للاستهداف انفجارها.
counters.why_en: Highlander ignores Swirlseed's slow, and Alpha Strike's untargetable dash dodges her burst.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى اندفاع Alpha Strike غير القابل للاستهداف قفزة Cataclysm، وتتجاهل Highlander إبطاء Golden Aegis.
counters.why_en: Alpha Strike's untargetable dash dodges Cataclysm's leap, and Highlander shrugs off Golden Aegis's slow.

countered_by.why_ar: Scatter the Weak موجة قوة وليست مقذوفًا فلا تعكسها Rebuttal، وتشلّ Mel عند Dark Spheres.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak is a wave of force, not a projectile, so Rebuttal cannot reflect it, and it stuns Mel on Dark Spheres.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall كرة Solar Snare ووابل Radiant Volley.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Solar Snare's orb and Radiant Volley's barrage.

countered_by.why_ar: Hextech Ray شعاع وليس مقذوفًا فلا يصدّه انعكاس Rebuttal.
countered_by.why_en: Hextech Ray is a beam, not a projectile, so Rebuttal's reflect does not stop it.

counters.why_ar: تعكس Rebuttal بطاقات Wild Cards إلى Twisted Fate وتمنع الضرر عن Mel.
counters.why_en: Rebuttal reflects Wild Cards back at Twisted Fate and prevents her damage.

counters.why_ar: تعكس Rebuttal مقذوف Paddle Star إلى Zoe وتمنع الضرر عن Mel.
counters.why_en: Rebuttal reflects Paddle Star back at Zoe and prevents damage to Mel.

counters.why_ar: تعكس Rebuttal مقذوف Devastating Fire إلى Hwei.
counters.why_en: Rebuttal reflects Devastating Fire's projectile back at Hwei.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Milio بـ Rocket Grab بعيدًا عن حامله، وتُسكته Static Field.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Milio away from his carry, and Static Field silences him.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Milio بـ Last Embrace، ويضربه Piercing Darkness من بعيد.
countered_by.why_en: Last Embrace roots Milio, and Piercing Darkness pokes him from range.

countered_by.why_ar: تشلّ Milio بـ Crescendo، ويضيف Power Chord شللًا بعد 3 مهارات.
countered_by.why_en: Crescendo stuns Milio and Power Chord adds a stun after 3 casts.

counters.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Dark Binding وإبطاء Soul Shackles عن الحلفاء.
counters.why_en: Breath of Life removes Dark Binding's root and Soul Shackles' slow from allies.

counters.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Light Binding عن الحلفاء، ويدفع Lux بـ Ultra Mega Fire Kick للخلف.
counters.why_en: Breath of Life removes Light Binding's root from allies, and Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks Lux back.

counters.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Grasping Roots عن الحلفاء، وتضيف Warm Hugs درعًا وسرعة.
counters.why_en: Breath of Life removes Grasping Roots' root from allies, and Warm Hugs adds shield and speed.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Spell Shield مهارة Double Up، وتحسم سرعة هجوم Ricochet المبادلة.
countered_by.why_en: Spell Shield blocks Double Up, and Ricochet's attack speed wins the trade.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Bio-Arcane Barrage وضرره من أقصى الصحة على Miss Fortune، ويبطئها Void Ooze.
countered_by.why_en: Bio-Arcane Barrage's range and max-Health damage beat Miss Fortune, and Void Ooze slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Miss Fortune بـ Deadly Flourish، وتبعدها فخاخ Captive Audience عن Make It Rain.
countered_by.why_en: Deadly Flourish roots Miss Fortune, and Captive Audience's traps zone her out of Make It Rain.

counters.why_ar: يمنع إبطاء Make It Rain بطلَ Xayah من جمع الريش لتثبيت Bladecaller، وتمزّقها Bullet Time.
counters.why_en: Make It Rain's slow keeps Xayah from collecting Feathers for a Bladecaller root, and Bullet Time shreds her.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب منطقة إبطاء Make It Rain بطلَ Varus أثناء شحن Piercing Arrow، وتمزّقه Bullet Time.
counters.why_en: Make It Rain's slow zone punishes Varus while he charges Piercing Arrow, and Bullet Time shreds him.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب منطقة إبطاء Make It Rain اندفاعات Martial Poise، وتسبب Bullet Time ضررًا كبيرًا لـ Kalista.
counters.why_en: Make It Rain's slow zone punishes Martial Poise lunges, and Bullet Time deals large damage to Kalista.

countered_by.why_ar: تمنع مناعة Path Maker من الإزاحة Death's Grasp من سحب K'Sante.
countered_by.why_en: Path Maker's displacement immunity stops Death's Grasp from pulling K'Sante.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Mordekaiser بـ Radiant Blast ويراوغه مدى Divine Ascent، ويُنهي Starfire Spellblade صحته المنخفضة.
countered_by.why_en: Radiant Blast slows Mordekaiser and Divine Ascent's range kites him, with Starfire Spellblade finishing low Health.

countered_by.why_ar: يكسر ضرر Snip Snip الحقيقي درع Indestructible، وتتفوق Gwen داخل Realm of Death؛ ولا تمنع Hallowed Mist المهارة النهائية إلا إن كان Mordekaiser خارجها.
countered_by.why_en: Snip Snip's true damage breaks Indestructible's shield, and Gwen wins inside Realm of Death; Hallowed Mist only blocks the ultimate if he is outside it.

counters.why_ar: تعزل Garen بـ Realm of Death وتسرق إحصاءاته، ويتفوق درع Indestructible في المبادلة الطويلة.
counters.why_en: Realm of Death isolates Garen and steals his stats, and Indestructible's shield beats his sustained trading.

counters.why_ar: تعزل Malphite بـ Realm of Death وتسرق إحصاءاته، ويعالج درع Indestructible بطلَ Mordekaiser.
counters.why_en: Realm of Death isolates Malphite and steals his stats, and Indestructible's shield heals Mordekaiser.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Poppy بـ Death's Grasp، وتسرق Realm of Death إحصاءاتها.
counters.why_en: Death's Grasp pulls Poppy in, and Realm of Death steals her stats.

countered_by.why_ar: يطابق مدى Piercing Darkness مدى هجوم Senna المتزايد ويتفوق على Morgana.
countered_by.why_en: Piercing Darkness's cast range matches Senna's growing attack range and out-pokes Morgana.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Dark Binding وإبطاء Soul Shackles عن الحلفاء.
countered_by.why_en: Breath of Life removes Dark Binding's root and Soul Shackles' slow from allies.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Temporal Mirage مقذوف Dark Binding، وتسرّع Twisted Timeflow حركة Zilean.
countered_by.why_en: Temporal Mirage slows Dark Binding's projectile, and Twisted Timeflow speeds Zilean away.

counters.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield سحب Death Sentence ودفع Flay.
counters.why_en: Black Shield absorbs Death Sentence's pull and Flay's knockback.

counters.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield شلل Shield of Daybreak وتثبيت Zenith Blade.
counters.why_en: Black Shield absorbs Shield of Daybreak's stun and Zenith Blade's root.

counters.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield تثبيت Ring of Frost وشلل Frozen Tomb.
counters.why_en: Black Shield absorbs Ring of Frost's root and Frozen Tomb's stun.

countered_by.why_ar: يلغي Unbreakable ضرر أول هجمة ويقلّل الباقي، فيضعف حليف Nami المعزّز بـ Tidecaller's Blessing.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable negates the first attack and reduces the rest, blunting the ally Nami empowers with Tidecaller's Blessing.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Headbutt وPulverize Nami، وتزيل Unbreakable Will شلل Aqua Prison عن Alistar.
countered_by.why_en: Headbutt and Pulverize lock Nami down, and Unbreakable Will removes her Aqua Prison stun.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Nami بـ Dredge Line، ويثبّتها Staggering Blow.
countered_by.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Nami in, and Staggering Blow roots her.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Soraka بـ Aqua Prison، ويتفوق Ebb and Flow على علاجها.
counters.why_en: Aqua Prison stuns Soraka, and Ebb and Flow out-trades her heals.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Rakan بـ Aqua Prison بعد Grand Entrance، وتطيح به Tidal Wave.
counters.why_en: Aqua Prison stuns Rakan after Grand Entrance, and Tidal Wave knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Rell بـ Aqua Prison قبل Crashdown، وتطيح بها Tidal Wave.
counters.why_en: Aqua Prison stuns Rell before Crashdown, and Tidal Wave knocks her up.

countered_by.why_ar: تراوغ ضربات The Darkin Blade الواسعة وUmbral Dash Nasus الذي يحتاج Wither إلى المدى القريب.
countered_by.why_en: The Darkin Blade's wide swings and Umbral Dash kite Nasus, whose Wither needs melee range.

countered_by.why_ar: يتحرر Decisive Strike من إبطاء Wither ويُسكت Nasus.
countered_by.why_en: Decisive Strike breaks free of Wither's slows and silences Nasus.

countered_by.why_ar: تراوغ Boomerang Throw وHop Nasus الذي يحتاج المدى القريب لتجميع Siphoning Strike.
countered_by.why_en: Boomerang Throw and Hop kite Nasus, who needs melee range to stack Siphoning Strike.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Wither سرعة حركة Tryndamere وهجومه، ويخفض Spirit Fire دروعه (Armor).
counters.why_en: Wither decelerates Tryndamere's Movement and Attack Speed, and Spirit Fire cuts his Armor.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Kennen بـ Wither، وتضيف Fury of the Sands دروعًا (Armor) ومقاومة سحر (MR) ضد ضرره السحري.
counters.why_en: Wither slows Kennen, and Fury of the Sands adds Armor and Magic Resistance against his magic damage.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Wither سرعة حركة Kayle وهجومها، ويخفض Spirit Fire دروعها (Armor) بينما Divine Ascent ما زالت ضعيفة.
counters.why_en: Wither decelerates Kayle's Movement and Attack Speed, and Spirit Fire cuts her Armor while her Divine Ascent is still weak.

countered_by.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable مرساة Dredge Line، ويبطئ Nautilus بـ Winter's Bite.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Dredge Line's anchor, and Winter's Bite slows Nautilus.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Nautilus بـ Zenith Blade ويشلّه Shield of Daybreak، وتبقي Leona بـ Eclipse حيّة أمام Dredge Line.
countered_by.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Nautilus, Shield of Daybreak stuns him, and Eclipse keeps Leona alive through Dredge Line.

countered_by.why_ar: يكسر Shattering Strike درع Titan's Wrath ويشلّ Nautilus.
countered_by.why_en: Shattering Strike breaks Titan's Wrath's shield and stuns Nautilus.

counters.why_ar: تضرب موجات Riptide المبطئة Yuumi وحاملها معًا، وتسحب Dredge Line الحامل بعيدًا عنها.
counters.why_en: Riptide's slowing waves hit Yuumi and her carry together, and Dredge Line drags the carry away from her.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Blitzcrank بـ Dredge Line، ويحسم درع Titan's Wrath المبادلة.
counters.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Blitzcrank in, and Titan's Wrath's shield wins the trade.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Poppy بـ Dredge Line، ويثبّتها Staggering Blow.
counters.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Poppy in, and Staggering Blow roots her.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Dragon Strike بـ Nidalee، وتمنع ساحة Cataclysm مراوغتها بـ Pounce.
countered_by.why_en: Dragon Strike's lunge knocks Nidalee up, and Cataclysm's arena stops her Pounce kiting.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Nidalee بـ Devastating Charge للخلف، وتجعلها موجة رعب Onslaught of Shadows تهرب.
countered_by.why_en: Devastating Charge's knockback lands on Nidalee, and Onslaught of Shadows' terror makes her flee.

countered_by.why_ar: تغلق Audacious Charge المسافة نحو Nidalee، وتطيح بها الضربة الثالثة من Three Talon Strike.
countered_by.why_en: Audacious Charge closes on Nidalee, and Three Talon Strike's third attack knocks her up.

counters.why_ar: تتفوق Javelin Toss على Graves مدى، ويكشفه Bushwhack وسط Smoke Screen.
counters.why_en: Javelin Toss outranges Graves, and Bushwhack reveals him through Smoke Screen.

counters.why_ar: يكشف فخ Bushwhack بطلَ Fiddlesticks، وتضربه Javelin Toss من بعيد.
counters.why_en: Bushwhack's trap reveals Fiddlesticks, and Javelin Toss pokes him from range.

counters.why_ar: يكشف Kha'Zix بـ Bushwhack من الخفاء، وتضربه Javelin Toss.
counters.why_en: Bushwhack reveals Kha'Zix out of invisibility, and Javelin Toss pokes him.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Phosphorus Bomb وMissile Barrage من بعيد، وتخفض Gatling Gun الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Nilah.
countered_by.why_en: Phosphorus Bomb and Missile Barrage poke from range, and Gatling Gun strips Nilah's Armor and Magic Resist.

countered_by.why_ar: يقلّل Hail of Arrows علاج Nilah الذاتي، ويشلّ Chain of Corruption حركتها قبل الاندفاع.
countered_by.why_en: Hail of Arrows reduces Nilah's self healing, and Chain of Corruption immobilizes her before she dashes.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Bio-Arcane Barrage على Formless Blade، ويبطئ Void Ooze اقتراب Nilah.
countered_by.why_en: Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges Formless Blade, and Void Ooze slows Nilah's approach.

counters.why_ar: تتفادى Jubilant Veil الهجمات التي تطبّق Deadly Venom، وتغلق Slipstream المسافة نحو Twitch.
counters.why_en: Jubilant Veil dodges the attacks that apply Deadly Venom, and Slipstream closes on Twitch.

counters.why_ar: تغلق Slipstream المسافة، وتسحب Ezreal بـ Apotheosis قبل مدى Arcane Shift.
counters.why_en: Slipstream closes the gap, and Apotheosis pulls Ezreal back from Arcane Shift range.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Tristana بـ Apotheosis، وتتفادى Jubilant Veil هجماتها.
counters.why_en: Apotheosis pulls Tristana in, and Jubilant Veil dodges her attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تتجاوز Powerball وSoaring Slam صدّ Shroud of Darkness الواحد، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر.
countered_by.why_en: Powerball and Soaring Slam overwhelm Shroud of Darkness's single block, and Defensive Ball Curl returns damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تستدرج نسخة Warrior Trickster صدّ Shroud of Darkness الواحد، وتطيح Cyclone بـ Nocturne.
countered_by.why_en: Warrior Trickster's clone baits Shroud of Darkness's single block, and Cyclone knocks Nocturne up.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Infected Bonesaw من الصحة الحالية وإبطاؤه صدّ Shroud of Darkness الواحد، وتعالج Dr. Mundo بـ Maximum Dosage.
countered_by.why_en: Infected Bonesaw's current-Health damage and slow get through Shroud of Darkness's single block, and Maximum Dosage heals him.

counters.why_ar: تقلّص Paranoia رؤية Kha'Zix ويصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Leap.
counters.why_en: Paranoia cuts Kha'Zix's sight and Shroud of Darkness blocks Leap.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Bandage Toss فيبقى Amumu بلا بداية.
counters.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Bandage Toss, leaving Amumu without his engage.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Impale، ويعاقب رعب Unspeakable Horror بطلَ Skarner.
counters.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Impale, and Unspeakable Horror's fear punishes Skarner.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Norra بـ Fate Sealed، ويطيح اندفاع Mortal Steel بها في الهواء.
countered_by.why_en: Fate Sealed pulls Norra in, and Mortal Steel's dash knocks her airborne.

countered_by.why_ar: يغلق Shunpo المسافة نحو Norra، وتطبّق Death Lotus تقليل العلاج.
countered_by.why_en: Shunpo closes on Norra, and Death Lotus applies healing reduction.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ قفص Event Horizon بطلَ Norra عند عبورها، وتضربها Dark Matter.
countered_by.why_en: Event Horizon's cage stuns Norra when she walks through, and Dark Matter pokes her.

counters.why_ar: Journey to Nowhere منطقة نفي وليست مقذوفًا فلا يصدّها Wind Wall، ولا يستطيع Yasuo استخدام المهارات أثناء النفي.
counters.why_en: Journey to Nowhere is a banish zone, not a projectile, so Wind Wall cannot stop it, and Yasuo cannot cast while banished.

counters.why_ar: لا يستطيع Ekko المنفي استخدام Chronobreak، وتبطئه Thread Sigils من Threads of Homecoming وتكبّر حجمه.
counters.why_en: A banished Ekko cannot cast Chronobreak, and Thread Sigils from Threads of Homecoming slow him and enlarge his hitbox.

counters.why_ar: تنفي Orianna بـ Journey to Nowhere فلا تستطيع استخدام Command: Shockwave، ويتفوق سهم Memory Surge المشحون عليها.
counters.why_en: Journey to Nowhere banishes Orianna so she cannot cast Command: Shockwave, and Memory Surge's charged bolt out-pokes her.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness تثبيت Snowball Barrage، ويسرّع مسار Duskbringer مطاردة Nocturne.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Snowball Barrage's root, and Duskbringer's trail speeds Nocturne's chase.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Ragnarok بطلَ Olaf محصّنًا ضد تثبيت Snowball Barrage وإطاحة Biggest Snowball Ever!.
countered_by.why_en: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to Snowball Barrage's root and Biggest Snowball Ever!'s knock up.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Resonating Strike نحو Nunu، وتقذفه Dragon's Rage بعيدًا عن تجهيز Willump، ويبطئه Cripple.
countered_by.why_en: Resonating Strike dashes onto Nunu, Dragon's Rage launches him away from Willump's setup, and Cripple slows him.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Biggest Snowball Ever! بـ Amumu قبل Bandage Toss، وتبطئه Absolute Zero.
counters.why_en: Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks Amumu up before Bandage Toss, and Absolute Zero slows him.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Biggest Snowball Ever! بـ Pantheon ويثبّته Snowball Barrage بعد Shield Vault.
counters.why_en: Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks Pantheon up, and Snowball Barrage roots him after Shield Vault.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Snowball Barrage ويطيح Biggest Snowball Ever! بـ Master Yi، بينما تمنع Highlander الإبطاء فقط.
counters.why_en: Snowball Barrage roots and Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks up Master Yi; Highlander only blocks slows.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Highlander بطلَ Master Yi محصّنًا ضد إبطاء Undertow، ويُنهك Olaf بـ Wuju Style بضرر حقيقي.
countered_by.why_en: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to Undertow's slow, and Wuju Style's true damage wears Olaf down.

countered_by.why_ar: يراوغ إبطاء Swirlseed وسرعة Blooming Blows بطلَ Olaf قبل Ragnarok، وتضرب Watch Out! Eep! بقوة في المركز.
countered_by.why_en: Swirlseed's slow and Blooming Blows' speed kite Olaf before Ragnarok, and Watch Out! Eep! hits hard in the center.

countered_by.why_ar: يراوغ Dance of Arrows وإبطاء Mounting Dread بطلَ Olaf، وتبقي Kindred بـ Lamb's Respite حيّة أمام اندفاعه.
countered_by.why_en: Dance of Arrows and Mounting Dread's slow kite Olaf, and Lamb's Respite keeps Kindred alive through his burst.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Ragnarok بطلَ Olaf محصّنًا ضد التعطيل، ومنه شلل Bandage Toss وCurse of the Sad Mummy.
counters.why_en: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to disables, including Bandage Toss's stun and Curse of the Sad Mummy.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Ragnarok بطلَ Olaf محصّنًا ضد Frenzying Taunt، ويتجاهل ضرر Reckless Swing الحقيقي دروع Rammus.
counters.why_en: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to Frenzying Taunt, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores Rammus's armor.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Reckless Swing الحقيقي وامتصاص Vicious Strikes على Urgot رغم إبطاء Corrosive Charge.
counters.why_en: Reckless Swing's true damage and Vicious Strikes' vamp out-trade Urgot through Corrosive Charge's slow.

countered_by.why_ar: تشلّ Orianna بـ Falling Star، وتكشفها Breath of Light وتتفوق عليها مدى.
countered_by.why_en: Falling Star stuns Orianna, and Breath of Light reveals and out-ranges her.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Orianna بـ Pyromania، وتفجّرها قفزة Tibbers.
countered_by.why_en: Pyromania stuns Orianna, and Tibbers' pounce bursts her.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Orianna بـ Nevermove ويسحبها، وتخترق Death's Hand.
countered_by.why_en: Nevermove roots and pulls Orianna in, and Death's Hand pierces through.

counters.why_ar: تخفف الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) من Command: Protect ضرر Transfusion وHemoplague.
counters.why_en: Command: Protect's Armor and Magic Resist blunt Transfusion and Hemoplague.

counters.why_ar: يمتص درع Command: Protect انفجار Vex، وتقذفها Command: Shockwave نحو الكرة.
counters.why_en: Command: Protect's shield absorbs Vex's burst, and Command: Shockwave launches her toward the Ball.

counters.why_ar: تقذف Viktor بـ Command: Shockwave نحو الكرة، وتبطئه Command: Dissonance.
counters.why_en: Command: Shockwave launches Viktor toward the Ball, and Command: Dissonance slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Way of the Hunter السحري تكديس دروع Ornn.
countered_by.why_en: Way of the Hunter's magic damage bypasses Ornn's armor stacking.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Valor ضرر Volcanic Rupture، ويشلّ Ornn بـ Ki Burst.
countered_by.why_en: Valor blocks Volcanic Rupture's damage, and Ki Burst stuns Ornn.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Twilight Assault ضررًا من أقصى الصحة فيتفوق على تكديس مقاومة Ornn.
countered_by.why_en: Twilight Assault deals max-Health damage, beating Ornn's resistance stacking.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Searing Charge بـ Teemo ويبطئه Volcanic Rupture.
counters.why_en: Searing Charge knocks Teemo up, and Volcanic Rupture slows him.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Gnar بـ Volcanic Rupture، وتطيح به Searing Charge.
counters.why_en: Volcanic Rupture slows Gnar, and Searing Charge knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Jayce بـ Volcanic Rupture، وتطيح به Searing Charge رغم ضرباته.
counters.why_en: Volcanic Rupture slows Jayce, and Searing Charge knocks him up through his poke.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness شلل Shield Vault، ويرعب Pantheon بـ Unspeakable Horror.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Shield Vault's stun, and Unspeakable Horror fears Pantheon.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Pantheon بـ Grasping Roots، وتطيح Stranglethorns به في الهواء.
countered_by.why_en: Grasping Roots roots Pantheon, and Stranglethorns knock him airborne.

countered_by.why_ar: تلاحق Pantheon بـ Cease and Desist، ويسبب Denting Blows ضررًا من أقصى الصحة.
countered_by.why_en: Cease and Desist runs Pantheon down, and Denting Blows deals max-Health damage.

counters.why_ar: تصدّ حصانة Aegis Assault الأمامية هجمات Jax، ويشلّه Shield Vault.
counters.why_en: Aegis Assault's front invulnerability blocks Jax's attacks, and Shield Vault stuns him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Kayle بـ Shield Vault، ويصدّ Aegis Assault مهارة Radiant Blast القادمة من الأمام.
counters.why_en: Shield Vault stuns Kayle, and Aegis Assault blocks her Radiant Blast from the front.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Talon بـ Shield Vault، ويصدّ Aegis Assault بحصانة الأمام خناجر Rake.
counters.why_en: Shield Vault stuns Talon, and Aegis Assault's front invulnerability blocks Rake's daggers.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Knuckle Down ضررًا من أقصى الصحة، ويسبب Haymaker ضررًا حقيقيًا يتجاوز تكديس دروع Poppy.
countered_by.why_en: Knuckle Down deals max-Health damage, and Haymaker deals true damage through Poppy's Armor stacking.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Poppy بـ Death's Grasp، وتسرق Realm of Death إحصاءاتها.
countered_by.why_en: Death's Grasp pulls Poppy in, and Realm of Death steals her stats.

countered_by.why_ar: ينهك نزيف Hemorrhage المتراكم وتجاهل Apprehend للدروع (Armor) Poppy.
countered_by.why_en: Hemorrhage's stacking bleed and Apprehend's Armor ignore wear Poppy down.

counters.why_ar: يوقف Steadfast Presence قفزة Volibear ويبطئه، ويبعده Keeper's Verdict بعيدًا.
counters.why_en: Steadfast Presence stops Volibear's leap and slows him, and Keeper's Verdict knocks him far away.

counters.why_ar: يوقف Steadfast Presence اندفاع Lunge ويثبّت Fiora على الأرض.
counters.why_en: Steadfast Presence stops Lunge's dash and grounds Fiora.

counters.why_ar: يوقف Steadfast Presence اندفاعات Drakehound's Step لدى Ambessa، ويشلّها Heroic Charge عند الجدار.
counters.why_en: Steadfast Presence stops Ambessa's Drakehound's Step dashes, and Heroic Charge stuns her at a wall.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Pyke بـ Twisted Advance، ويدفعه Bramble Smash للخلف ويبطئه.
countered_by.why_en: Twisted Advance roots Pyke, and Bramble Smash knocks him back and slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Pyke بـ Dredge Line، ويثبّته Staggering Blow، ويشلّه Depth Charge.
countered_by.why_en: Dredge Line pulls Pyke in, Staggering Blow roots him, and Depth Charge stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Pyke بـ Equinox فتمنع Bone Skewer، وتبطئه Starcall.
countered_by.why_en: Equinox silences Pyke, blocking Bone Skewer, and Starcall slows him.

counters.why_ar: يمهّد تمويه Ghostwater Dive لسحب Bone Skewer لـ Sona، وتُعدمها Death From Below.
counters.why_en: Ghostwater Dive's camouflage sets up a Bone Skewer pull on Sona, and Death From Below executes her.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Seraphine بـ Bone Skewer، ويشلّها Phantom Undertow، وتُعدمها Death From Below.
counters.why_en: Bone Skewer pulls Seraphine in, Phantom Undertow stuns her, and Death From Below executes her.

counters.why_ar: يمهّد تمويه Ghostwater Dive لـ Bone Skewer على Senna، ويشلّها Phantom Undertow.
counters.why_en: Ghostwater Dive's camouflage sets up Bone Skewer on Senna, and Phantom Undertow stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Rakan بـ Aqua Prison بعد Grand Entrance، وتطيح به Tidal Wave.
countered_by.why_en: Aqua Prison stuns Rakan after Grand Entrance, and Tidal Wave knocks him up.

countered_by.why_ar: تسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل على Rakan، وتسحره Encore.
countered_by.why_en: Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun on Rakan, and Encore charms him.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Rakan بـ Grasping Roots، وتطيح Stranglethorns به في الهواء.
countered_by.why_en: Grasping Roots roots Rakan, and Stranglethorns knock him airborne.

counters.why_ar: تسحر Soraka بـ The Quickness وتطيح بها Grand Entrance قبل وضع Equinox.
counters.why_en: The Quickness charms Soraka and Grand Entrance knocks her up before Equinox is placed.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Grand Entrance بـ Braum وتسحره The Quickness، وليست أيٌّ منهما مقذوفًا يعترضه Unbreakable.
counters.why_en: Grand Entrance knocks Braum up and The Quickness charms him, and neither is a projectile Unbreakable can intercept.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Grand Entrance بـ Yuumi وتسحرها The Quickness.
counters.why_en: Grand Entrance knocks Yuumi up, and The Quickness charms her.

countered_by.why_ar: Bountiful Harvest وCrowstorm مهارات وليست هجمات عادية، فلا يعمل انعكاس Defensive Ball Curl.
countered_by.why_en: Bountiful Harvest and Crowstorm are abilities, so Defensive Ball Curl's reflect against basic attackers never triggers.

countered_by.why_ar: يخترق ضرر Jaws of the Beast من أقصى الصحة تكديس دروع Rammus ويعالج Warwick.
countered_by.why_en: Jaws of the Beast's max-Health damage cuts through Rammus's armor stacking and heals Warwick.

countered_by.why_ar: يحوّل Cursed Touch ضرر Amumu السحري إلى ضرر حقيقي إضافي ضد مقاومة سحر Rammus.
countered_by.why_en: Cursed Touch turns Amumu's magic damage into extra true damage against Rammus's Magic Resistance.

counters.why_ar: يعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إلى هجمات Rengar العادية ويرفع الدروع (Armor) ضد انفجاره الفيزيائي.
counters.why_en: Defensive Ball Curl returns damage to Rengar's basic attacks and raises Armor against his physical burst.

counters.why_ar: يجبر Lee Sin بـ Frenzying Taunt على الهجوم، ويبطئه Powerball.
counters.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Lee Sin to attack, and Powerball slows him.

counters.why_ar: يجبر Master Yi بـ Frenzying Taunt على الهجوم، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl ضرره.
counters.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Master Yi to attack, and Defensive Ball Curl returns his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Unbreakable Will شلل Shattering Strike، ويتجاهل Trample تصادم الوحدات فيبقى على Rell.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable Will removes Shattering Strike's stun, and Trample ignores unit collision to stay on Rell.

countered_by.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable رمح Shattering Strike، ويشلّ Rell بـ Concussive Blows بعد 4 شحنات.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Shattering Strike's lance, and Concussive Blows stuns Rell after 4 stacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life شلل Shattering Strike، ويدفع Rell بـ Ultra Mega Fire Kick للخلف ويبطئها.
countered_by.why_en: Breath of Life removes Shattering Strike's stun, and Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks Rell back and slows her.

counters.why_ar: يكسر Shattering Strike درع Titan's Wrath ويشلّ Nautilus.
counters.why_en: Shattering Strike breaks Titan's Wrath's shield and stuns Nautilus.

counters.why_ar: يكسر Shattering Strike درع Mana Barrier لدى Blitzcrank ويشلّه.
counters.why_en: Shattering Strike breaks Blitzcrank's Mana Barrier shield and stuns him.

counters.why_ar: يكسر Shattering Strike درع Black Shield ويشلّ Morgana.
counters.why_en: Shattering Strike breaks Black Shield and stuns Morgana.

countered_by.why_ar: يبتعد Hop عن Slice and Dice، وتبطئ Renekton بـ Boomerang Throw أثناء الاقتراب.
countered_by.why_en: Hop kites away from Slice and Dice, and Boomerang Throw slows Renekton on approach.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases أول شلّ للحركة فيضيع شلل Ruthless Predator.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, so Ruthless Predator's stun is wasted.

countered_by.why_ar: يستفز Renekton بـ Shadow Dash، ويصدّ Spirit's Refuge هجماته.
countered_by.why_en: Shadow Dash taunts Renekton, and Spirit's Refuge blocks his attacks.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Ambessa بـ Ruthless Predator، ويغلق Slice and Dice المسافة نحوها.
counters.why_en: Ruthless Predator stuns Ambessa, and Slice and Dice closes on her.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Riven بـ Ruthless Predator، ويعالج Renekton بـ Cull the Meek.
counters.why_en: Ruthless Predator stuns Riven, and Cull the Meek heals Renekton.

counters.why_ar: لا يستطيع Wind Wall إيقاف Cull the Meek أو Ruthless Predator، ويغلق Slice and Dice المسافة نحو Yasuo.
counters.why_en: Wind Wall cannot stop Cull the Meek or Ruthless Predator, and Slice and Dice closes on Yasuo.

countered_by.why_ar: يعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إلى هجمات Rengar العادية ويرفع الدروع (Armor) ضد انفجاره الفيزيائي.
countered_by.why_en: Defensive Ball Curl returns damage to Rengar's basic attacks and raises Armor against his physical burst.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف دفع Devastating Charge كمين Rengar، وتجعله رعب Onslaught of Shadows يهرب.
countered_by.why_en: Devastating Charge's knockback stops Rengar's ambush, and Onslaught of Shadows' terror makes him flee.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Dragon Strike بـ Rengar، وتحاصره ساحة Cataclysm.
countered_by.why_en: Dragon Strike knocks Rengar up, and Cataclysm's arena traps him.

counters.why_ar: تكشف Evelynn بـ Thrill of the Hunt، ويبطئها Bola Strike ويكشفها.
counters.why_en: Thrill of the Hunt reveals Evelynn, and Bola Strike slows and reveals her.

counters.why_ar: ضرر Savagery الحرج وتثبيت Bola Strike بقوة Ferocity يحاصران Viego قبل Heartbreaker.
counters.why_en: Savagery's crit burst and Ferocity's Bola Strike root pin Viego before Heartbreaker.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Talon بـ Bola Strike ويكشفه من Shadow Assault، وتتبعه Thrill of the Hunt.
counters.why_en: Bola Strike slows and reveals Talon out of Shadow Assault, and Thrill of the Hunt tracks him.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Riven بـ Ruthless Predator، ويعالج Renekton بـ Cull the Meek.
countered_by.why_en: Ruthless Predator stuns Riven, and Cull the Meek heals Renekton.

countered_by.why_ar: تسرق Seismic Shard سرعة حركة Riven، وتطيح بها Unstoppable Force.
countered_by.why_en: Seismic Shard steals Riven's Movement Speed, and Unstoppable Force knocks her up.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Courage شلل Ki Burst، ويُسكت Riven بـ Decisive Strike.
countered_by.why_en: Courage resists Ki Burst's stun, and Decisive Strike silences Riven.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Valor ضرر Rupture، ويشلّ Cho'Gath بـ Ki Burst.
counters.why_en: Valor blocks Rupture's damage, and Ki Burst stuns Cho'Gath.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Valor ضرر Sett، ويشلّه Ki Burst.
counters.why_en: Valor blocks Sett's damage, and Ki Burst stuns him.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Valor ضرر Volcanic Rupture، ويشلّ Ornn بـ Ki Burst.
counters.why_en: Valor blocks Volcanic Rupture's damage, and Ki Burst stuns Ornn.

countered_by.why_ar: تغلق سرعة Thundering Smash المسافة نحو Rumble وتشلّه، ويمتص درع Sky Splitter ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Smash's speed closes on Rumble and stuns him, and Sky Splitter's shield absorbs his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يتحرر Decisive Strike من إبطاء Electro Harpoon ويُسكت Rumble.
countered_by.why_en: Decisive Strike breaks Electro Harpoon's slow and silences Rumble.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Electro Harpoon، ويبطئ Rumble بـ Chum the Waters ويطيح به.
countered_by.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, dodging Electro Harpoon, and Chum the Waters slows and knocks Rumble up.

counters.why_ar: يخفض Electro Harpoon مقاومة سحر K'Sante (MR) ويبطئه، ويذيبه ضرر Flamespitter السحري.
counters.why_en: Electro Harpoon reduces K'Sante's Magic Resist and slows him, and Flamespitter's magic damage melts him.

counters.why_ar: Flamespitter وElectro Harpoon ليستا هجمات عادية فلا يصدّهما Spirit's Refuge، ويخفض الحربون مقاومة سحر Shen (MR).
counters.why_en: Flamespitter and Electro Harpoon are not attacks, so Spirit's Refuge cannot block them, and the harpoon cuts Shen's Magic Resist.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Sion بـ Electro Harpoon ويخفض مقاومة سحره (MR)، ويبطئه جدار نار The Equalizer مجددًا.
counters.why_en: Electro Harpoon slows Sion and cuts his Magic Resist, and The Equalizer's flame wall slows him again.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Ryze بـ Singularity ويشلّه Falling Star فلا تصيب Rune Prison.
countered_by.why_en: Singularity pulls Ryze in and Falling Star stuns him, so Rune Prison never lands.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Ryze بـ Scatter the Weak عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئه Force of Will.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak stuns Ryze on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Ryze دون استهداف، ويمهّد Living Shadow للانفجار.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Ryze untargetable, and Living Shadow sets up the burst.

counters.why_ar: يضعف Spell Flux منطقة Akali، ويحاصرها Rune Prison خارج Twilight Shroud.
counters.why_en: Spell Flux debuffs Akali's area, and Rune Prison traps her out of Twilight Shroud.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Rune Prison بطلَ Lissandra المعلّمة بـ Flux، ويسبب Overload ضررًا إضافيًا.
counters.why_en: Rune Prison roots a Fluxed Lissandra, and Overload deals extra damage to her.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Rune Prison بطلَ Fizz المعلّم بـ Flux، ويعاقب ضرر Overload الإضافي اقترابه القصير.
counters.why_en: Rune Prison roots a Fluxed Fizz, and Overload's bonus damage punishes his short-range engage.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Flame Chompers Samira في موضع هبوط Wild Rush، وتبطئها Zap! وتكشفها.
countered_by.why_en: Flame Chompers root Samira where Wild Rush lands, and Zap! slows and reveals her.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Samira بـ Bladecaller عند إصابة 3 ريشات أو أكثر فيعاقب هبوط Wild Rush.
countered_by.why_en: Bladecaller roots Samira when 3 or more Feathers hit, punishing her Wild Rush landing.

countered_by.why_ar: يبقي مدى Bio-Arcane Barrage بطلَ Samira خارج ضررها الإضافي القريب، ويبطئها Void Ooze.
countered_by.why_en: Bio-Arcane Barrage's range keeps Samira out of her melee-range bonus damage, and Void Ooze slows her.

counters.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوفات Mystic Shot وEssence Flux فتبطل ضربات Ezreal من بعيد.
counters.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Mystic Shot and Essence Flux, shutting down his poke.

counters.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl مقذوفات Dancing Grenade وDeadly Flourish، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Jhin الذي لا يملك اندفاعًا.
counters.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Dancing Grenade and Deadly Flourish, and Wild Rush closes on a dashless Jhin.

counters.why_ar: تدمّر Blade Whirl رمح Pierce، وتغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Kalista.
counters.why_en: Blade Whirl destroys Pierce's spear, and Wild Rush closes on Kalista.

countered_by.why_ar: يمهّد تمويه Ghostwater Dive لـ Bone Skewer على Senna، ويشلّها Phantom Undertow.
countered_by.why_en: Ghostwater Dive's camouflage sets up Bone Skewer on Senna, and Phantom Undertow stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Senna بـ Death Sentence خارج مدى Relic Cannon، ويبطئها The Box.
countered_by.why_en: Death Sentence pulls Senna out of her Relic Cannon range, and The Box slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Senna بـ Rocket Grab خارج مدى Relic Cannon، وتُسكتها Static Field.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Senna out of her Relic Cannon range, and Static Field silences her.

counters.why_ar: يطابق مدى Piercing Darkness مدى هجوم Senna المتزايد ويتفوق على Morgana.
counters.why_en: Piercing Darkness's cast range matches Senna's growing attack range and out-pokes Morgana.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Piercing Darkness على Braum مدى، وتثبّته Last Embrace.
counters.why_en: Piercing Darkness outreaches Braum, and Last Embrace roots him.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Bard بـ Last Embrace، ويتفوق Relic Cannon عليه مدى.
counters.why_en: Last Embrace roots Bard, and Relic Cannon outranges him.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Seraphine بـ Bone Skewer، ويشلّها Phantom Undertow، وتُعدمها Death From Below.
countered_by.why_en: Bone Skewer pulls Seraphine in, Phantom Undertow stuns her, and Death From Below executes her.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Seraphine بـ Winter's Bite، ويشلّها Concussive Blows بعد 4 شحنات.
countered_by.why_en: Winter's Bite slows Seraphine, and Concussive Blows stuns her after 4 stacks.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Seraphine بـ Time Bomb، وتبطئ Temporal Mirage مقذوفاتها.
countered_by.why_en: Time Bomb stuns Seraphine, and Temporal Mirage slows her projectiles.

counters.why_ar: يسبب High Note ضررًا أكبر من صحة Soraka المفقودة، وتسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل.
counters.why_en: High Note deals more damage to Soraka's missing Health, and Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun.

counters.why_ar: تسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل على Rakan، وتسحره Encore.
counters.why_en: Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun on Rakan, and Encore charms him.

counters.why_ar: تسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل على Pantheon، ويضرب High Note صحته المفقودة.
counters.why_en: Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun on Pantheon, and High Note hits his missing Health.

countered_by.why_ar: تخفف دروع Thunderclap وتقليل سرعة هجوم Ground Slam ضرر Sett الفيزيائي.
countered_by.why_en: Thunderclap's Armor and Ground Slam's attack speed cut blunt Sett's physical damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يرمي Sett بـ Fling داخل Mega Adhesive فيثبّته، ويُنهكه Poison Trail.
countered_by.why_en: Fling lands Sett in Mega Adhesive to root him, and Poison Trail wears him down.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Sett بـ Volcanic Rupture، ويجعله Bellows Breath هشًّا، وتطيح به Searing Charge.
countered_by.why_en: Volcanic Rupture slows Sett, Bellows Breath makes him Brittle, and Searing Charge knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Knuckle Down ضررًا من أقصى الصحة، ويسبب Haymaker ضررًا حقيقيًا يتجاوز تكديس دروع Poppy.
counters.why_en: Knuckle Down deals max-Health damage, and Haymaker deals true damage through Poppy's Armor stacking.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Knuckle Down ضررًا من أقصى الصحة، ويشلّ Shen بـ Facebreaker إن وُجد أعداء على الجانبين.
counters.why_en: Knuckle Down deals max-Health damage, and Facebreaker stuns Shen if enemies are on both sides.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Knuckle Down من أقصى الصحة ودرع Haymaker على Irelia، ويشلّها Facebreaker.
counters.why_en: Knuckle Down's max-Health damage and Haymaker's shield beat Irelia, and Facebreaker stuns her.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Knuckle Down ضررًا من أقصى الصحة، ويشلّ Shen بـ Facebreaker إن وُجد أعداء على الجانبين.
countered_by.why_en: Knuckle Down deals max-Health damage, and Facebreaker stuns Shen if enemies are on both sides.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Shen بـ Shock Blast من بعيد، ويضيف Hyper Charge سرعة هجوم.
countered_by.why_en: Shock Blast pokes Shen from range, and Hyper Charge adds attack speed.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Deathbringer Stance ضررًا من أقصى الصحة ويعالج Aatrox رغم تحمّل Shen.
countered_by.why_en: Deathbringer Stance deals max-Health damage and heals Aatrox through Shen's tank stats.

counters.why_ar: يستفز Camille بـ Shadow Dash، ويصدّ Spirit's Refuge هجماتها.
counters.why_en: Shadow Dash taunts Camille, and Spirit's Refuge blocks her attacks.

counters.why_ar: يستفز Renekton بـ Shadow Dash، ويصدّ Spirit's Refuge هجماته.
counters.why_en: Shadow Dash taunts Renekton, and Spirit's Refuge blocks his attacks.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Twilight Assault ضررًا من أقصى الصحة ويبطئ Nasus عند هروبه.
counters.why_en: Twilight Assault deals max-Health damage and slows Nasus when he runs away.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Shyvana بـ Infected Bonesaw، ويخزّن Heart Zapper ضررها ويعالج Dr. Mundo.
countered_by.why_en: Infected Bonesaw slows Shyvana, and Heart Zapper stores her damage and heals Dr. Mundo.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Shyvana بـ Blade's Reach، وتفجّرها Umbral Trespass من الداخل.
countered_by.why_en: Blade's Reach slows Shyvana, and Umbral Trespass bursts her from inside.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Shyvana بـ Swirlseed، وتنيمها Lilting Lullaby.
countered_by.why_en: Swirlseed slows Shyvana, and Lilting Lullaby puts her to sleep.

counters.why_ar: تعلّم Hecarim بـ Flame Breath لضرر من أقصى الصحة عند الضربة، ويدفعه Dragon's Descent نحوها.
counters.why_en: Flame Breath marks Hecarim for max-Health on-hit damage, and Dragon's Descent knocks him toward her.

counters.why_ar: تعلّم Aatrox بـ Flame Breath لضرر من أقصى الصحة عند الضربة، وتُنهكه نار Burnout.
counters.why_en: Flame Breath marks Aatrox for max-Health on-hit damage, and Burnout's fire wears him down.

counters.why_ar: تعلّم Amumu بـ Flame Breath لضرر من أقصى الصحة عند الضربة، وتعاقب نار Burnout بنيته البطيئة.
counters.why_en: Flame Breath marks Amumu for max-Health on-hit damage, and Burnout's fire punishes his slow tanky frame.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases أول شلّ للحركة، مثل تثبيت Fling داخل Mega Adhesive.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, like Fling's root in Mega Adhesive.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Divine Ascent على Singed، ويبطئه Radiant Blast.
countered_by.why_en: Divine Ascent's range outreaches Singed, and Radiant Blast slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Singed بـ Thundering Shuriken، وتتفوق سرعة Lightning Rush على Poison Trail.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Shuriken pokes Singed, and Lightning Rush's speed outruns his Poison Trail.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Aatrox بـ Mega Adhesive ويثبّته على الأرض فيوقف Umbral Dash.
counters.why_en: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds Aatrox, stopping his Umbral Dash.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Malphite بـ Mega Adhesive على الأرض ويبطئه، ويثبّته Fling داخله.
counters.why_en: Mega Adhesive grounds and slows Malphite, and Fling roots him in it.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Gwen بـ Mega Adhesive ويثبّتها على الأرض، ويثبّتها Fling داخله.
counters.why_en: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds Gwen, and Fling roots her in it.

countered_by.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Way of the Hunter السحري تكديس دروع Sion، وتسحبه Fate Sealed.
countered_by.why_en: Way of the Hunter's magic damage bypasses Sion's armor stacking, and Fate Sealed pulls him in.

countered_by.why_ar: يقاوم Goes Where He Pleases أول شلّ للحركة فيضيع شلل Decimating Smash.
countered_by.why_en: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, wasting Decimating Smash's stun.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب Twilight Assault ضررًا من أقصى الصحة لـ Sion، ويصدّ Spirit's Refuge هجماته.
countered_by.why_en: Twilight Assault deals max-Health damage to Sion, and Spirit's Refuge blocks his attacks.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Teemo بـ Roar of the Slayer ويخفض دروعه (Armor)، ويمتص درع Soul Furnace ضرره.
counters.why_en: Roar of the Slayer slows Teemo and cuts his Armor, and Soul Furnace's shield absorbs his damage.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Decimating Smash بـ Urgot ويشلّه، ويمتص درع Soul Furnace ضرره.
counters.why_en: Decimating Smash knocks Urgot up and stuns him, and Soul Furnace's shield absorbs his damage.

counters.why_ar: تطيح Unstoppable Onslaught بـ Taliyah ويبطئها Roar of the Slayer.
counters.why_en: Unstoppable Onslaught knocks Taliyah up, and Roar of the Slayer slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: لا يستطيع Spell Shield إيقاف Deadly Venom الذي يصيب مع كل هجمة عادية بضرر حقيقي.
countered_by.why_en: Spell Shield cannot stop Deadly Venom, which hits with every basic attack as true damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى Relentless Pursuit مهارة Boomerang Blade، وتتجاوز ضربات Lightslinger المزدوجة درع Spell Shield.
countered_by.why_en: Relentless Pursuit dodges Boomerang Blade, and Lightslinger double-shots overwhelm Spell Shield.

countered_by.why_ar: تتجاوز سهام Volley التسعة وإبطاء Frost Shot درع Spell Shield الذي يصدّ مهارة واحدة فقط.
countered_by.why_en: Volley's 9 arrows and Frost Shot's slow overwhelm Spell Shield, which blocks only one ability.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Spell Shield مهارة Double Up، وتحسم سرعة هجوم Ricochet المبادلة.
counters.why_en: Spell Shield blocks Double Up, and Ricochet's attack speed wins the trade.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Spell Shield مهارة Essence Flux أو Mystic Shot، ويتفوق Boomerang Blade عليه في الضرب من بعيد.
counters.why_en: Spell Shield blocks Essence Flux or Mystic Shot, and Boomerang Blade out-pokes him.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Spell Shield شلّ Chain of Corruption، وتكسب Sivir صحة وسرعة عند الصدّ.
counters.why_en: Spell Shield blocks Chain of Corruption's immobilize, and Sivir heals and speeds up when it does.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Impale، ويعاقب رعب Unspeakable Horror بطلَ Skarner.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Impale, and Unspeakable Horror's fear punishes Skarner.

countered_by.why_ar: يراوغ Reaping Slash وBlade's Reach Skarner، وتفجّره Umbral Trespass.
countered_by.why_en: Reaping Slash and Blade's Reach kite Skarner, and Umbral Trespass bursts him.

countered_by.why_ar: تنيم Skarner بـ Lilting Lullaby ويبطئه Swirlseed.
countered_by.why_en: Lilting Lullaby puts Skarner to sleep, and Swirlseed slows him.

counters.why_ar: تخضع Jarvan IV بـ Impale قبل هبوط Cataclysm، ويبطئه Seismic Bastion.
counters.why_en: Impale suppresses Jarvan IV before Cataclysm lands, and Seismic Bastion slows him.

counters.why_ar: تخضع Ambessa بـ Impale أثناء اندفاعها، ويخفف درع Seismic Bastion وإبطاؤه ضرر Lacerate.
counters.why_en: Impale suppresses Ambessa mid-dash, and Seismic Bastion's shield and slow blunt Lacerate.

counters.why_ar: تصدم Gragas بـ Ixtal's Impact بالجدار فتشلّه، وتخضعه Impale.
counters.why_en: Ixtal's Impact slams Gragas into a wall to stun him, and Impale suppresses him.

countered_by.why_ar: تعاقب ضربات Lightslinger المزدوجة Smolder قبل أن تكبر شحنات Dragon Practice.
countered_by.why_en: Lightslinger double-shots punish Smolder before his Dragon Practice stacks scale.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى Arcane Shift مهارة ACHOOO!، وتضرب Mystic Shot وEssence Flux Smolder قبل تجمّع شحنات Dragon Practice.
countered_by.why_en: Arcane Shift dodges ACHOOO!, and Mystic Shot and Essence Flux poke Smolder before Dragon Practice stacks build.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Slipstream وApotheosis Smolder إلى القتال القريب، حيث تتفادى Jubilant Veil هجماته.
countered_by.why_en: Slipstream and Apotheosis pull Smolder into melee, where Jubilant Veil dodges his attacks.

counters.why_ar: يمزج Super Scorcher Breath ضررًا فيزيائيًا وسحريًا، وتُعدم شحناته من المستوى 3 Corki منخفض الصحة بضرر حقيقي.
counters.why_en: Super Scorcher Breath mixes physical and magic damage and its level 3 stacks execute low-health Corki with true damage.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب انفجارات ACHOOO! المتتالية وإعدام Super Scorcher Breath بضرر حقيقي صحة Twitch المنخفضة.
counters.why_en: ACHOOO!'s chained explosions and Super Scorcher Breath's true-damage execute punish Twitch's low health.

counters.why_ar: يطير Flap, Flap, Flap فوق التضاريس فلا يشلّه Condemn عند الجدار، ويتفوق Super Scorcher Breath عليها في الضرر.
counters.why_en: Flap, Flap, Flap flies over terrain so Condemn's wall stun cannot trap him, and Super Scorcher Breath out-damages her.

countered_by.why_ar: يمهّد تمويه Ghostwater Dive لسحب Bone Skewer لـ Sona، وتُعدمها Death From Below.
countered_by.why_en: Ghostwater Dive's camouflage sets up a Bone Skewer pull on Sona, and Death From Below executes her.

countered_by.why_ar: تمسك Rocket Grab بطلَ Sona الهشة وتُسكتها Static Field قبل جاهزية Power Chord.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab catches fragile Sona and Static Field silences her before Power Chord is ready.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Sona بـ Zenith Blade، وتمنح Eclipse الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لتتحمل Leona ضرباتها.
countered_by.why_en: Zenith Blade roots Sona, and Eclipse's Armor and Magic Resist let Leona survive her pokes.

counters.why_ar: تضرب Janna بـ Hymn of Valor، وتعالج Aria of Perseverance ضرر Zephyr.
counters.why_en: Hymn of Valor pokes Janna, and Aria of Perseverance heals through her Zephyr damage.

counters.why_ar: تتفوق Hymn of Valor على Glitterlance، وتشلّ Lulu بـ Crescendo عند أول إصابة.
counters.why_en: Hymn of Valor out-pokes Glitterlance, and Crescendo stuns Lulu on the first hit.

counters.why_ar: تتفوق Hymn of Valor وAria of Perseverance على Alistar في الاستمرارية قبل وصوله إلى Sona.
counters.why_en: Hymn of Valor and Aria of Perseverance out-sustain Alistar before he reaches Sona.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Soraka بـ Aqua Prison، ويتفوق Ebb and Flow على علاجها.
countered_by.why_en: Aqua Prison stuns Soraka, and Ebb and Flow out-trades her heals.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Soraka بـ Rocket Grab، ويوقف إسكات Static Field علاجها.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Soraka in, and Static Field's silence stops her heals.

countered_by.why_ar: يسبب High Note ضررًا أكبر من صحة Soraka المفقودة، وتسلسل Beat Drop الإبطاء ثم التثبيت ثم الشلل.
countered_by.why_en: High Note deals more damage to Soraka's missing Health, and Beat Drop chains slow, root and stun.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Pyke بـ Equinox فتمنع Bone Skewer، وتبطئه Starcall.
counters.why_en: Equinox silences Pyke, blocking Bone Skewer, and Starcall slows him.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Alistar بـ Equinox فتمنع Headbutt وPulverize، وتثبّته عند انتهائها.
counters.why_en: Equinox silences Alistar, stopping Headbutt and Pulverize, and roots him when it expires.

counters.why_ar: تُسكت Morgana بـ Equinox فتمنع Black Shield وDark Binding، وتبطئها Starcall.
counters.why_en: Equinox silences Morgana, stopping Black Shield and Dark Binding, and Starcall slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: تنيم Swain بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble، وتضربه Paddle Star.
countered_by.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Swain to sleep, and Paddle Star pokes him.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Tectonic Disruption بـ Swain قبل Nevermove، ويبطئه Plasma Fission.
countered_by.why_en: Tectonic Disruption knocks Swain up before Nevermove, and Plasma Fission slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تضع Swain بـ Tempered Fate في جمود وتشلّه، ويبطئه Cosmic Binding.
countered_by.why_en: Tempered Fate puts Swain in stasis and stuns him, and Cosmic Binding slows him.

counters.why_ar: تستنزف Demonic Ascension صحة Galio، ويثبّته Nevermove بعد Justice Punch.
counters.why_en: Demonic Ascension drains Galio's Health, and Nevermove roots him after Justice Punch.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Orianna بـ Nevermove ويسحبها، وتخترق Death's Hand.
counters.why_en: Nevermove roots and pulls Orianna in, and Death's Hand pierces through.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Nautilus بـ Nevermove، وتستنزف Demonic Ascension صحته.
counters.why_en: Nevermove roots Nautilus, and Demonic Ascension drains his Health.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Crushing Maw Sylas ويبطئه، وتضربه Severing Bolt من بعيد.
countered_by.why_en: Crushing Maw draws Sylas in and slows him, and Severing Bolt pokes from long range.

countered_by.why_ar: يخفف درع Hero's Entrance السحري انفجار Sylas، ويستفزه Shield of Durand.
countered_by.why_en: Hero's Entrance's magic shield blunts Sylas's burst, and Shield of Durand taunts him.

countered_by.why_ar: يقطع Doom 'N Gloom اندفاع Abscond ويرعب Sylas.
countered_by.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom interrupts Abscond's dash and fears Sylas.

counters.why_ar: تسرق Hijack مهارة Chum the Waters، ويعالج Sylas بـ Kingslayer ضد Fizz.
counters.why_en: Hijack steals Chum the Waters, and Kingslayer heals Sylas against Fizz.

counters.why_ar: تسرق Hijack مهارة Death Mark، ويبطئ Zed بـ Chain Lash.
counters.why_en: Hijack steals Death Mark, and Chain Lash slows Zed.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Abscond/Abduct Sylas نحو Aurelion Sol، وتسرق Hijack مهارة Falling Star.
counters.why_en: Abscond/Abduct pulls Sylas onto Aurelion Sol, and Hijack steals Falling Star.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Syndra دون استهداف، وتضربها Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Syndra untargetable, and Razor Shuriken hits through his shadows.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Playful بطلَ Fizz غير قابل للاستهداف، ويبطئ Syndra بـ Chum the Waters ويطيح بها.
countered_by.why_en: Playful makes Fizz untargetable, and Chum the Waters slows and knocks Syndra up.

countered_by.why_ar: يتدحرج Phase Dive خارج مهارات Syndra وينتقل إليها، وتعيد Chronobreak الزمن بعد انفجارها.
countered_by.why_en: Phase Dive rolls out of Syndra's spells and teleports onto her, and Chronobreak rewinds her burst.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Vex بـ Scatter the Weak ويشلّها عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئها Force of Will.
counters.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Vex back and stuns her on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows her.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Ryze بـ Scatter the Weak عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئه Force of Will.
counters.why_en: Scatter the Weak stuns Ryze on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows him.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Veigar بـ Scatter the Weak ويشلّه عند Dark Spheres، وتضرب Unleashed Power بقوة.
counters.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Veigar back and stuns him on Dark Spheres, and Unleashed Power hits hard.

countered_by.why_ar: يقوم Phase Dive بالانتقال بدل الاندفاع فلا تنفجر ألغام Unraveled Earth.
countered_by.why_en: Phase Dive teleports instead of dashing, so Unraveled Earth's mines do not trigger.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Taliyah دون استهداف، ويمهّد Living Shadow للانفجار.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Taliyah untargetable, and Living Shadow sets up the burst.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Taliyah بـ Command: Shockwave نحو الكرة، وتبطئها Command: Dissonance.
countered_by.why_en: Command: Shockwave pulls Taliyah toward the Ball, and Command: Dissonance slows her.

counters.why_ar: تنفجر ألغام Unraveled Earth عند عبور اندفاع Leap Strike لدى Jax، ويرميه Seismic Shove بعيدًا.
counters.why_en: Unraveled Earth's mines explode when Jax's Leap Strike dashes through, and Seismic Shove throws him off.

counters.why_ar: تعاقب ألغام Unraveled Earth اندفاع Resonating Strike، ويرمي Lee Sin بـ Seismic Shove بعيدًا.
counters.why_en: Unraveled Earth's mines punish Resonating Strike's dash, and Seismic Shove throws Lee Sin away.

counters.why_ar: تنفجر ألغام Unraveled Earth عند عبور Spirit Rush، ويرمي Ahri بـ Seismic Shove بعيدًا.
counters.why_en: Unraveled Earth's mines explode when Spirit Rush dashes through, and Seismic Shove throws Ahri off.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Talon بـ Bola Strike ويكشفه من Shadow Assault، وتتبعه Thrill of the Hunt.
countered_by.why_en: Bola Strike slows and reveals Talon out of Shadow Assault, and Thrill of the Hunt tracks him.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Spirit Cleave انفجار Talon، وتسحبه Fate Sealed.
countered_by.why_en: Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs Talon's burst, and Fate Sealed pulls him in.

countered_by.why_ar: تكشف Talon بـ Tempest خارج Shadow Assault، وتندفع Resonating Strike نحوه.
countered_by.why_en: Tempest reveals Talon out of Shadow Assault, and Resonating Strike dashes onto him.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Kha'Zix بـ Rake، ويفجّره Noxian Diplomacy عند عزله.
counters.why_en: Rake slows Kha'Zix, and Noxian Diplomacy bursts him when isolated.

counters.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Talon الفيزيائي درع Void Stone السحري، ويبطئ Kassadin بـ Rake.
counters.why_en: Talon's physical damage ignores Void Stone's magic shield, and Rake slows Kassadin.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Diana بـ Rake، ويقفز Assassin's Path بـ Talon فوق التضاريس نحوها.
counters.why_en: Rake slows Diana, and Assassin's Path vaults Talon over terrain onto her.

countered_by.why_ar: تطيح Searing Charge بـ Teemo ويبطئه Volcanic Rupture.
countered_by.why_en: Searing Charge knocks Teemo up, and Volcanic Rupture slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Teemo بـ Roar of the Slayer ويخفض دروعه (Armor)، ويمتص درع Soul Furnace ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Roar of the Slayer slows Teemo and cuts his Armor, and Soul Furnace's shield absorbs his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Bladesurge نحو Teemo، ويشلّه Flawless Duet.
countered_by.why_en: Bladesurge dashes onto Teemo, and Flawless Duet stuns him.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات Volibear بلا ضرر، ويراوغه Move Quick.
counters.why_en: Blinding Dart makes Volibear's attacks deal no damage, and Move Quick kites him.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات Tryndamere بلا ضرر، ويراوغه Move Quick.
counters.why_en: Blinding Dart makes Tryndamere's attacks deal no damage, and Move Quick kites him.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات Camille المعزّزة بلا ضرر.
counters.why_en: Blinding Dart makes Camille's empowered attacks deal no damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص Black Shield سحب Death Sentence ودفع Flay.
countered_by.why_en: Black Shield absorbs Death Sentence's pull and Flay's knockback.

countered_by.why_ar: يعترض Unbreakable سلسلة Death Sentence قبل وصولها إلى حامل Braum.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable intercepts Death Sentence's chain before it reaches Braum's carry.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Thresh بـ Magnet Storm، وتسرق Break the Mold دروعه (Armor) ومقاومة سحره (MR).
countered_by.why_en: Magnet Storm pulls Thresh in, and Break the Mold steals his Armor and Magic Resist.

counters.why_ar: تسلسل Bard بـ Death Sentence وتسحبه، ويدفعه Flay للخلف.
counters.why_en: Death Sentence chains and pulls Bard in, and Flay knocks him back.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Death Sentence حامل Yuumi بعيدًا، ويفرّقهما Flay.
counters.why_en: Death Sentence pulls Yuumi's carry away, and Flay knocks them apart.

counters.why_ar: يسحب Senna بـ Death Sentence خارج مدى Relic Cannon، ويبطئها The Box.
counters.why_en: Death Sentence pulls Senna out of her Relic Cannon range, and The Box slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: تخفض Caustic Spittle الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) لدى Tristana، وتضرب Bio-Arcane Barrage من أقصى صحتها.
countered_by.why_en: Caustic Spittle shreds Tristana's Armor and Magic Resist, and Bio-Arcane Barrage deals max-health damage.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Missile Barrage وPhosphorus Bomb Tristana قبل Rocket Jump، وتخفض Gatling Gun دروعها (Armor) ومقاومة سحرها (MR).
countered_by.why_en: Missile Barrage and Phosphorus Bomb poke Tristana before Rocket Jump, and Gatling Gun cuts her Armor and Magic Resist.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Tristana بـ Zap! وتثبّته Flame Chompers في موضع هبوط Rocket Jump.
countered_by.why_en: Zap! slows Tristana and Flame Chompers root her where Rocket Jump lands.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Zeri بـ Buster Shot بعيدًا عن مراوغتها، ويبطئها Rocket Jump.
counters.why_en: Buster Shot knocks Zeri back out of her kiting, and Rocket Jump slows her.

counters.why_ar: يوقف ارتداد Buster Shot وإبطاء Rocket Jump اندفاع سرعة الهجوم من Cultivation of Spirit لدى Yunara.
counters.why_en: Buster Shot's knockback and Rocket Jump's slow stop Yunara's Cultivation of Spirit attack-speed rush.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Kai'Sa بـ Buster Shot بعد Killer Instinct، ويتفوق مدى Draw a Bead عليها.
counters.why_en: Buster Shot knocks Kai'Sa back after Killer Instinct, and Draw a Bead outranges her.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Tryndamere بـ Frenzying Taunt على مهاجمة Rammus، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إليه.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Tryndamere to attack Rammus, and Defensive Ball Curl returns the damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يجعل Blinding Dart هجمات Tryndamere بلا ضرر، ويراوغه Move Quick.
countered_by.why_en: Blinding Dart makes Tryndamere's attacks deal no damage, and Move Quick kites him.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Tryndamere بـ Corrosive Charge، ويرميه Disdain بعيدًا عن الطريق.
countered_by.why_en: Corrosive Charge slows Tryndamere, and Disdain hurls him out of the way.

counters.why_ar: يخفض Mocking Shout قوة هجوم Ambessa (AD)، وتصمد Undying Rage أمام اندفاعها.
counters.why_en: Mocking Shout lowers Ambessa's Attack Damage, and Undying Rage outlasts her burst.

counters.why_ar: يخفض Mocking Shout قوة هجوم Garen (AD)، وتصمد Undying Rage أمام Demacian Justice.
counters.why_en: Mocking Shout lowers Garen's Attack Damage, and Undying Rage outlasts Demacian Justice.

counters.why_ar: يخفض Mocking Shout قوة هجوم Riven (AD)، وتصمد Undying Rage أمام كومبوها.
counters.why_en: Mocking Shout lowers Riven's Attack Damage, and Undying Rage outlasts her combo.

countered_by.why_ar: تعكس Rebuttal بطاقات Wild Cards إلى Twisted Fate وتمنع الضرر عن Mel.
countered_by.why_en: Rebuttal reflects Wild Cards back at Twisted Fate and prevents her damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall بطاقات Wild Cards وهي ضربة Twisted Fate الرئيسية.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Wild Cards, Twisted Fate's main poke.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Death Mark بطلَ Zed غير قابل للاستهداف أثناء الاندفاع نحو Twisted Fate، وتضربه Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable as he dashes onto Twisted Fate, and Razor Shuriken pokes him through his shadows.

counters.why_ar: تكشف Akali بـ Destiny من Twilight Shroud، وتشلّها Gold Card من Pick a Card.
counters.why_en: Destiny reveals Akali out of Twilight Shroud, and Pick a Card's Gold Card stuns her.

counters.why_ar: تشلّ Gold Card من Pick a Card بطلَ Lissandra، وتبطئها Red Card.
counters.why_en: Pick a Card's Gold Card stuns Lissandra, and Red Card slows her.

counters.why_ar: تشلّ Gold Card من Pick a Card بطلَ Irelia، وتبطئها Red Card.
counters.why_en: Pick a Card's Gold Card stuns Irelia, and Red Card slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: تغلق Wild Rush المسافة نحو Twitch، وتدمّر Blade Whirl قارورة Venom Cask.
countered_by.why_en: Wild Rush closes on Twitch, and Blade Whirl destroys Venom Cask.

countered_by.why_ar: تتفادى Jubilant Veil الهجمات التي تطبّق Deadly Venom، وتغلق Slipstream المسافة نحو Twitch.
countered_by.why_en: Jubilant Veil dodges the attacks that apply Deadly Venom, and Slipstream closes on Twitch.

countered_by.why_ar: تعاقب انفجارات ACHOOO! المتتالية وإعدام Super Scorcher Breath بضرر حقيقي صحة Twitch المنخفضة.
countered_by.why_en: ACHOOO!'s chained explosions and Super Scorcher Breath's true-damage execute punish Twitch's low health.

counters.why_ar: لا يستطيع Spell Shield إيقاف Deadly Venom الذي يصيب مع كل هجمة عادية بضرر حقيقي.
counters.why_en: Spell Shield cannot stop Deadly Venom, which hits with every basic attack as true damage.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى تمويه Ambush مهارة Piercing Arrow، ويتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروع Varus.
counters.why_en: Ambush's camouflage avoids Piercing Arrow, and Deadly Venom's true damage ignores Varus's armor.

counters.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروع Jinx، ويبطئها Venom Cask.
counters.why_en: Deadly Venom's true damage ignores Jinx's armor, and Venom Cask slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Decimating Smash بـ Urgot ويشلّه، ويمتص درع Soul Furnace ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Decimating Smash knocks Urgot up and stuns him, and Soul Furnace's shield absorbs his damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Urgot بـ Facebreaker ويشلّه، ويسبب Knuckle Down ضررًا من أقصى الصحة.
countered_by.why_en: Facebreaker pulls and stuns Urgot, and Knuckle Down deals max-Health damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق ضرر Reckless Swing الحقيقي وامتصاص Vicious Strikes على Urgot رغم إبطاء Corrosive Charge.
countered_by.why_en: Reckless Swing's true damage and Vicious Strikes' vamp out-trade Urgot through Corrosive Charge's slow.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق درع Disdain ورميه على سحب Apprehend لدى Darius، ويبطئه Corrosive Charge.
counters.why_en: Disdain's shield and hurl beat Darius's Apprehend pull, and Corrosive Charge slows him.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Tryndamere بـ Corrosive Charge، ويرميه Disdain بعيدًا عن الطريق.
counters.why_en: Corrosive Charge slows Tryndamere, and Disdain hurls him out of the way.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Teemo بـ Corrosive Charge، وتُعدمه Fear Beyond Death عند انخفاض صحته.
counters.why_en: Corrosive Charge slows Teemo, and Fear Beyond Death executes him at low health.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى قفز Featherstorm غير القابل للاستهداف مهارة Chain of Corruption، ويثبّت Varus بـ Bladecaller.
countered_by.why_en: Featherstorm's untargetable leap dodges Chain of Corruption, and Bladecaller roots Varus.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى تمويه Ambush مهارة Piercing Arrow، ويتجاهل ضرر Deadly Venom الحقيقي دروع Varus.
countered_by.why_en: Ambush's camouflage avoids Piercing Arrow, and Deadly Venom's true damage ignores Varus's armor.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفادى Spark Surge مهارة Piercing Arrow، وتبطئ Varus بـ Ultrashock Laser.
countered_by.why_en: Spark Surge dodges Piercing Arrow, and Ultrashock Laser slows Varus.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Piercing Arrow على Vayne، ويشلّ Chain of Corruption حركتها فلا يعيد Tumble تموضعها.
counters.why_en: Piercing Arrow outranges Vayne, and Chain of Corruption immobilizes her so Tumble cannot reposition.

counters.why_ar: يقلّل Hail of Arrows علاج Nilah الذاتي، ويشلّ Chain of Corruption حركتها قبل الاندفاع.
counters.why_en: Hail of Arrows reduces Nilah's self healing, and Chain of Corruption immobilizes her before she dashes.

counters.why_ar: يتفوق Piercing Arrow على Tristana مدى، ويشلّ Chain of Corruption حركتها بعد Rocket Jump.
counters.why_en: Piercing Arrow outranges Tristana, and Chain of Corruption immobilizes her after Rocket Jump.

countered_by.why_ar: يتفوق مدى Piercing Arrow على Vayne، ويشلّ Chain of Corruption حركتها فلا يعيد Tumble تموضعها.
countered_by.why_en: Piercing Arrow outranges Vayne, and Chain of Corruption immobilizes her so Tumble cannot reposition.

countered_by.why_ar: يهرب اندفاع وليزر Transcend One's Self المبطئ من تجهيز Condemn، وتتفوق Cultivation of Spirit على Vayne.
countered_by.why_en: Transcend One's Self's dash and slowing laser escape Condemn's setup, and Cultivation of Spirit out-trades Vayne.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Yordle Snap Trap حركة Vayne ويتضاعف مدى Headshot على المحاصرين، فلا يفيد Tumble في الاقتراب.
countered_by.why_en: Yordle Snap Trap immobilizes Vayne and Headshot's doubled range on trapped targets stops Tumble from closing in.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Zeri بـ Condemn ويشلّها عند الجدار، ويسبب Silver Bolts ضررًا حقيقيًا من أقصى الصحة.
counters.why_en: Condemn knocks Zeri back and stuns her on a wall, and Silver Bolts deals max-Health true damage.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Xayah بـ Condemn بعيدًا عن ريشها، ويسبب Silver Bolts ضررًا حقيقيًا من أقصى الصحة.
counters.why_en: Condemn knocks Xayah away from her Feathers, and Silver Bolts deals max-health true damage.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Ezreal بـ Condemn ويشلّه عند الجدار، ويسبب Silver Bolts ضررًا حقيقيًا من أقصى الصحة.
counters.why_en: Condemn knocks Ezreal back and stuns him on a wall, and Silver Bolts deals max-Health true damage.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Veigar بـ Scatter the Weak ويشلّه عند Dark Spheres، وتضرب Unleashed Power بقوة.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Veigar back and stuns him on Dark Spheres, and Unleashed Power hits hard.

countered_by.why_ar: ينتقل Shunpo فوريًا إلى Veigar، وتمزّقه Death Lotus قبل Primordial Burst.
countered_by.why_en: Shunpo blinks onto Veigar, and Death Lotus shreds him before Primordial Burst.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Death Mark بطلَ Zed غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Primordial Burst، وتضربه Razor Shuriken.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable, dodging Primordial Burst, and Razor Shuriken pokes him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Vladimir بـ Event Horizon عند عبوره، ويزداد ضرر Primordial Burst مع صحته المفقودة.
counters.why_en: Event Horizon stuns Vladimir passing through, and Primordial Burst scales with his missing Health.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ قفص Event Horizon بطلَ Orianna عند عبورها، وتضربها Dark Matter.
counters.why_en: Event Horizon's cage stuns Orianna when she walks through, and Dark Matter pokes her.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ قفص Event Horizon بطلَ Annie عند عبورها، وتضربها Baleful Strike.
counters.why_en: Event Horizon's cage stuns Annie when she walks through, and Baleful Strike pokes her.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Vel'Koz دون استهداف، وتضربه Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Vel'Koz untargetable, and Razor Shuriken hits through his shadows.

countered_by.why_ar: يصل تمويه Going Rogue وHeroic Swing إلى Vel'Koz، ويتفوق Avengerang عليه.
countered_by.why_en: Going Rogue's camouflage and Heroic Swing reach Vel'Koz, and Avengerang out-pokes him.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Vel'Koz بـ Rocket Grab، وتُسكته Static Field قبل Life Form Disintegration Ray.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab drags Vel'Koz in, and Static Field silences him before Life Form Disintegration Ray.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Tectonic Disruption بـ Swain قبل Nevermove، ويبطئه Plasma Fission.
counters.why_en: Tectonic Disruption knocks Swain up before Nevermove, and Plasma Fission slows him.

counters.why_ar: يطيح Tectonic Disruption بـ Brand، ويبطئه Plasma Fission.
counters.why_en: Tectonic Disruption knocks Brand up, and Plasma Fission slows him.

counters.why_ar: يسبب Life Form Disintegration Ray ضررًا حقيقيًا لـ Braum المدروس متجاهلًا دروعه (Armor) ومقاومة سحره (MR).
counters.why_en: Life Form Disintegration Ray deals true damage to a Researched Braum, ignoring his Armor and Magic Resist.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Vex بـ Scatter the Weak ويشلّها عند Dark Spheres، ويبطئها Force of Will.
countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Vex back and stuns her on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Command: Protect انفجار Vex، وتقذفها Command: Shockwave نحو الكرة.
countered_by.why_en: Command: Protect's shield absorbs Vex's burst, and Command: Shockwave launches her toward the Ball.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Severing Bolt Vex من بعيد، ويرعبها Grim Visage ويبطئها.
countered_by.why_en: Severing Bolt pokes Vex from long range, and Grim Visage fears and slows her.

counters.why_ar: يرعب Katarina بـ Doom 'N Gloom، ويمتص درع Personal Space مهارة Death Lotus.
counters.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom fears Katarina, and Personal Space's shield absorbs Death Lotus.

counters.why_ar: يقطع Doom 'N Gloom قفزة Across the Veil، ويصيب رعب Vex Aurora.
counters.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom interrupts Across the Veil's leap, and Vex's fear lands on Aurora.

counters.why_ar: يقطع رعب Doom 'N Gloom اندفاعات Ahri ومنها Spirit Rush.
counters.why_en: Doom 'N Gloom's fear interrupts Ahri's dashes, including Spirit Rush.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Shroud of Darkness مهارة Cease and Desist، بداية Vi المستهدفة.
countered_by.why_en: Shroud of Darkness blocks Cease and Desist, Vi's targeted engage.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Vi بـ Frenzying Taunt على الهجوم، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إلى هجماتها العادية.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Vi to attack, and Defensive Ball Curl returns damage to her basic attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تسرّع Warwick بـ Bloodhunt نحو Vi منخفضة الصحة، وتخضعها Infinite Duress.
countered_by.why_en: Bloodhunt speeds Warwick toward a low-health Vi, and Infinite Duress suppresses her.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Lillia بـ Vault Breaker للخلف، وتلاحقها Cease and Desist.
counters.why_en: Vault Breaker knocks Lillia back, and Cease and Desist runs her down.

counters.why_ar: يعاقب ضرر Denting Blows من أقصى الصحة وVault Breaker Evelynn قبل استخدامها Last Caress.
counters.why_en: Denting Blows' max-Health damage and Vault Breaker punish Evelynn before she can Last Caress.

counters.why_ar: تلاحق Pantheon بـ Cease and Desist، ويسبب Denting Blows ضررًا من أقصى الصحة.
counters.why_en: Cease and Desist runs Pantheon down, and Denting Blows deals max-Health damage.

countered_by.why_ar: ضرر Savagery الحرج وتثبيت Bola Strike بقوة Ferocity يحاصران Viego قبل Heartbreaker.
countered_by.why_en: Savagery's crit burst and Ferocity's Bola Strike root pin Viego before Heartbreaker.

countered_by.why_ar: يجبر Viego بـ Frenzying Taunt على مهاجمة Rammus، ويعيد Defensive Ball Curl الضرر إلى هجماته العادية.
countered_by.why_en: Frenzying Taunt forces Viego to attack Rammus, and Defensive Ball Curl returns damage to his basic attacks.

countered_by.why_ar: تمنع Lamb's Respite موت أي وحدة فتحرم Viego من إعدام Heartbreaker ومن شبح Sovereign's Domination.
countered_by.why_en: Lamb's Respite stops anything from dying, denying Viego's Heartbreaker execute and Sovereign's Domination wraith.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Graves بـ Spectral Maw، وتُعدمه Heartbreaker.
counters.why_en: Spectral Maw stuns Graves, and Heartbreaker executes him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Warwick بـ Spectral Maw قبل Infinite Duress، ويسرق Blade of the Ruined King الصحة.
counters.why_en: Spectral Maw stuns Warwick before Infinite Duress, and Blade of the Ruined King steals Health.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Shyvana بـ Spectral Maw قبل Dragon's Descent، وتُعدمها Heartbreaker.
counters.why_en: Spectral Maw stuns Shyvana before Dragon's Descent, and Heartbreaker executes her.

countered_by.why_en: Scatter the Weak knocks Viktor back and stuns him on Dark Spheres, and Force of Will slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تقذف Viktor بـ Command: Shockwave نحو الكرة، وتبطئه Command: Dissonance.
countered_by.why_en: Command: Shockwave launches Viktor toward the Ball, and Command: Dissonance slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Viktor بـ Null Sphere، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضرره.
countered_by.why_en: Null Sphere silences Viktor, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs his damage.

counters.why_ar: يبطئ Swain بـ Gravity Field ويشلّه إن بقي داخله، ويمتص درع Siphon Power ضرره.
counters.why_en: Gravity Field slows and stuns Swain if he stays inside, and Siphon Power's shield absorbs his damage.

counters.why_ar: Hextech Ray شعاع وليس مقذوفًا فلا يصدّه انعكاس Rebuttal.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Veigar بـ Gravity Field إن بقي داخله، وتضربه Hextech Ray.
counters.why_en: Gravity Field stuns Veigar if he stays inside, and Hextech Ray pokes him.

countered_by.why_ar: تخفف الدروع (Armor) ومقاومة السحر (MR) من Command: Protect ضرر Transfusion وHemoplague.

counters.why_en: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable, dodging Frozen Tomb, and siphons Lissandra's life.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Sanguine Pool بطلَ Vladimir غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى Fate Sealed ويبطئ Yone.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Sanguine Pool بطلَ Vladimir غير قابل للاستهداف فيتفادى The Hextech Ultimatum ويبطئ Camille.
counters.why_en: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable, dodging The Hextech Ultimatum, and slows Camille.

counters.why_en: Thundering Smash stuns Xin Zhao on the first attack, and Sky Splitter slows him.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Irelia بـ Thundering Smash، ويعالج Volibear بـ Frenzied Maul.
