countered_by.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Warwick before Infinite Duress, and Despair drains his max Health every second.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Last Caress بطلَ Evelynn غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Infinite Duress، وتبطئ Warwick بـ Allure أو تسحره.
countered_by.why_en: Last Caress makes Evelynn untargetable, dodging Infinite Duress, and Allure slows or charms Warwick.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Warwick بـ Ntofo Strikes، ويمتص درع Footwork مهارة Jaws of the Beast.
countered_by.why_en: Ntofo Strikes stuns Warwick, and Footwork's shield absorbs Jaws of the Beast.

counters.why_ar: يخترق ضرر Jaws of the Beast من أقصى الصحة تكديس دروع Rammus ويعالج Warwick.
counters.why_en: Jaws of the Beast's max-Health damage cuts through Rammus's armor stacking and heals Warwick.

counters.why_ar: تخضع Jarvan IV بـ Infinite Duress قبل Cataclysm، ويتفوق تقليل ضرر Primal Howl على اندفاعه.
counters.why_en: Infinite Duress suppresses Jarvan IV before Cataclysm, and Primal Howl's damage reduction beats his burst.

counters.why_ar: تخضع Jayce بـ Infinite Duress، وتسرّع Warwick بـ Bloodhunt نحوه عند انخفاض صحته.
counters.why_en: Infinite Duress suppresses Jayce, and Bloodhunt speeds Warwick toward him when low.

countered_by.why_ar: يبطئ Wukong بـ Swirlseed وتنيمه Lilting Lullaby قبل Cyclone.
countered_by.why_en: Swirlseed slows Wukong and Lilting Lullaby puts him to sleep before Cyclone.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Wukong بـ Bandage Toss قبل Cyclone، وتوقف Curse of the Sad Mummy قتاله.
countered_by.why_en: Bandage Toss stuns Wukong before Cyclone, and Curse of the Sad Mummy stops his clones' fight.

countered_by.why_ar: تطيح Unstoppable Force بـ Wukong، ويقلّل Ground Slam سرعة هجومه.
countered_by.why_en: Unstoppable Force knocks Wukong up, and Ground Slam cuts his attack speed.

counters.why_ar: تستدرج نسخة Warrior Trickster صدّ Shroud of Darkness الواحد، وتطيح Cyclone بـ Nocturne.
counters.why_en: Warrior Trickster's clone baits Shroud of Darkness's single block, and Cyclone knocks Nocturne up.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى اندفاع Warrior Trickster الخفي مهارة Spectral Maw، وتطيح Cyclone بـ Viego.
counters.why_en: Warrior Trickster's invisible dash dodges Spectral Maw, and Cyclone knocks Viego up.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى اندفاع Warrior Trickster الخفي مهارة Ruthless Predator، وتطيح Cyclone بـ Renekton.
counters.why_en: Warrior Trickster's invisible dash dodges Ruthless Predator, and Cyclone knocks Renekton up.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Enchanted Crystal Arrow ويبطئ Xayah بـ Frost Shot بعد قفز Featherstorm.
countered_by.why_en: Enchanted Crystal Arrow's stun and Frost Shot's slow catch Xayah after her Featherstorm leap.

countered_by.why_ar: يمنع إبطاء Make It Rain بطلَ Xayah من جمع الريش لتثبيت Bladecaller، وتمزّقها Bullet Time.
countered_by.why_en: Make It Rain's slow keeps Xayah from collecting Feathers for a Bladecaller root, and Bullet Time shreds her.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Flame Chompers Xayah، وتبطئها Zap! بينما يتفوق Fishbones عليها مدى.
countered_by.why_en: Flame Chompers root Xayah, and Zap! slows her while Fishbones outranges her.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى قفز Featherstorm غير القابل للاستهداف مهارة Chain of Corruption، ويثبّت Varus بـ Bladecaller.
counters.why_en: Featherstorm's untargetable leap dodges Chain of Corruption, and Bladecaller roots Varus.

counters.why_ar: يجعل Featherstorm بطلَ Xayah غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Whirling Death، ويثبّت Draven بـ Bladecaller.
counters.why_en: Featherstorm makes Xayah untargetable, dodging Whirling Death, and Bladecaller roots Draven.

counters.why_ar: يثبّت Samira بـ Bladecaller عند إصابة 3 ريشات أو أكثر فيعاقب هبوط Wild Rush.
counters.why_en: Bladecaller roots Samira when 3 or more Feathers hit, punishing her Wild Rush landing.

countered_by.why_ar: تمنع Xin Zhao بـ Curse of the Sad Mummy من الهجوم والحركة، وتستنزف Despair أقصى صحته.
countered_by.why_en: Curse of the Sad Mummy stops Xin Zhao from attacking or moving, and Despair drains his max Health.

countered_by.why_ar: يعكس Defensive Ball Curl ضرر هجمات Three Talon Strike العادية، ويجبره Frenzying Taunt على الاشتباك.
countered_by.why_en: Defensive Ball Curl reflects damage from Three Talon Strike's basic attacks, and Frenzying Taunt forces him in.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Xin Zhao بـ Thundering Smash عند أول هجمة، ويبطئه Sky Splitter.
countered_by.why_en: Thundering Smash stuns Xin Zhao on the first attack, and Sky Splitter slows him.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Crescent Guard بطلَ Xin Zhao محصّنًا من ضرر الأبطال خارج الدائرة فتبطل مدى Graves.
counters.why_en: Crescent Guard makes Xin Zhao impervious to champion damage from outside the circle, nullifying Graves's range.

counters.why_ar: تغلق Audacious Charge المسافة نحو Nidalee، وتطيح بها الضربة الثالثة من Three Talon Strike.
counters.why_en: Audacious Charge closes on Nidalee, and Three Talon Strike's third attack knocks her up.

counters.why_ar: تدفع Rengar بـ Crescent Guard للخلف وتحمي Xin Zhao من الضرر الخارجي، وتبطئه Audacious Charge.
counters.why_en: Crescent Guard knocks Rengar back and shields Xin Zhao from outside damage, and Audacious Charge slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: Breath of Light شعاع لا يصدّه Wind Wall، وتشلّ Yasuo بـ Falling Star.
countered_by.why_en: Breath of Light is a beam Wind Wall cannot block, and Falling Star stuns Yasuo.

countered_by.why_ar: Ring of Frost ليس مقذوفًا فلا يصدّه Wind Wall، ويثبّت Yasuo.
countered_by.why_en: Ring of Frost is not a projectile, so Wind Wall cannot stop it, and it roots Yasuo.

countered_by.why_ar: لا يستطيع Wind Wall إيقاف Cull the Meek أو Ruthless Predator، ويغلق Slice and Dice المسافة نحو Yasuo.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall cannot stop Cull the Meek or Ruthless Predator, and Slice and Dice closes on Yasuo.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall مقذوف Avengerang ورصاصات Comeuppance.
counters.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Avengerang and Comeuppance's Mist shots.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall مقذوف Paddle Star وهو مصدر ضرر Zoe الرئيسي.
counters.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Paddle Star, Zoe's main damage source.

counters.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall إبرة Needlework، ويندفع Sweeping Blade عبر Gwen.
counters.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Needlework's needle, and Sweeping Blade dashes through Gwen.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Yone بـ Ring of Frost، وتشلّه Frozen Tomb.
countered_by.why_en: Ring of Frost roots Yone, and Frozen Tomb stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: توقف Charm اندفاع Mortal Steel وانتقال Fate Sealed الفوري، ويتلقى Yone ضررًا أكبر من Ahri.
countered_by.why_en: Charm stops Mortal Steel's dash and Fate Sealed's blink, and Yone takes more damage from Ahri.

countered_by.why_ar: تثبّت Yone بـ The Hextech Ultimatum، وتطيح به Hookshot.
countered_by.why_en: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors Yone, and Hookshot knocks him up.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Norra بـ Fate Sealed، ويطيح اندفاع Mortal Steel بها في الهواء.
counters.why_en: Fate Sealed pulls Norra in, and Mortal Steel's dash knocks her airborne.

counters.why_ar: تسحب Hwei بـ Fate Sealed، ويمتص درع Spirit Cleave ضرباته.
counters.why_en: Fate Sealed pulls Hwei in, and Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs his poke.

counters.why_ar: يتجاوز ضرر Way of the Hunter السحري تكديس دروع Cho'Gath، ويمتص درع Spirit Cleave انفجاره.
counters.why_en: Way of the Hunter's magic damage bypasses Cho'Gath's armor stacking, and Spirit Cleave's shield absorbs his burst.

countered_by.why_ar: يوقف ارتداد Buster Shot وإبطاء Rocket Jump اندفاع سرعة الهجوم من Cultivation of Spirit لدى Yunara.
countered_by.why_en: Buster Shot's knockback and Rocket Jump's slow stop Yunara's Cultivation of Spirit attack-speed rush.

countered_by.why_ar: تبطئ Yunara بـ Ultrashock Laser وتضربه قبل تعزيز Transcend One's Self.
countered_by.why_en: Ultrashock Laser slows and pokes Yunara before her Transcend One's Self upgrade.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب Mystic Shot وEssence Flux Yunara قبل سرعة هجوم Cultivation of Spirit، وينجو Arcane Shift من إبطائها.
countered_by.why_en: Mystic Shot and Essence Flux poke Yunara before Cultivation of Spirit's attack speed, and Arcane Shift escapes her slows.

counters.why_ar: تتفوق سرعة الهجوم والضرر عند الضربة من Cultivation of Spirit على Icathian Rain لدى Kai'Sa.
counters.why_en: Cultivation of Spirit's attack speed and on-hit damage out-trade Kai'Sa's Icathian Rain.

counters.why_ar: يهرب اندفاع وليزر Transcend One's Self المبطئ من تجهيز Condemn، وتتفوق Cultivation of Spirit على Vayne.
counters.why_en: Transcend One's Self's dash and slowing laser escape Condemn's setup, and Cultivation of Spirit out-trades Vayne.

counters.why_ar: يبقي ليزر Transcend One's Self المبطئ Samira بعيدًا عن القتال القريب، وتضيف Cultivation of Spirit سرعة هجوم.
counters.why_en: Transcend One's Self's slowing laser keeps Samira out of melee range, and Cultivation of Spirit adds attack speed.

countered_by.why_ar: تضرب موجات Riptide المبطئة Yuumi وحاملها معًا، وتسحب Dredge Line الحامل بعيدًا عنها.
countered_by.why_en: Riptide's slowing waves hit Yuumi and her carry together, and Dredge Line drags the carry away from her.

countered_by.why_ar: يسحب Death Sentence حامل Yuumi بعيدًا، ويفرّقهما Flay.
countered_by.why_en: Death Sentence pulls Yuumi's carry away, and Flay knocks them apart.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Rocket Grab حامل Yuumi بعيدًا عنها، وتُسكتها Static Field.
countered_by.why_en: Rocket Grab pulls Yuumi's carry away from her, and Static Field silences her.

counters.why_ar: تجعل You and Me! بطلَ Yuumi غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Dark Binding.
counters.why_en: You and Me! makes Yuumi untargetable, dodging Dark Binding.

counters.why_ar: تجعل You and Me! بطلَ Yuumi غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى Twisted Advance، ويبطئ Maokai بـ Prowling Projectile.
counters.why_en: You and Me! makes Yuumi untargetable, dodging Twisted Advance, and Prowling Projectile slows Maokai.

counters.why_ar: تجعل You and Me! بطلَ Yuumi غير قابلة للاستهداف فتتفادى رابط Focused Resolve، ويبطئ Karma بـ Prowling Projectile.
counters.why_en: You and Me! makes Yuumi untargetable, dodging Focused Resolve's tether, and Prowling Projectile slows Karma.

countered_by.why_ar: يقلّل Defiant Dance ضرر Zed الفيزيائي، ويشلّه Flawless Duet.
countered_by.why_en: Defiant Dance reduces Zed's physical damage, and Flawless Duet stuns him.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Frozen Tomb على نفسها Lissandra محصّنة أثناء Death Mark، ويثبّت Zed بـ Ring of Frost.
countered_by.why_en: Frozen Tomb on herself makes Lissandra invulnerable through Death Mark, and Ring of Frost roots Zed.

countered_by.why_ar: يمتص درع Soul Furnace انفجار Zed، وتبقي Sion بـ Glory in Death يقاتل رغم Death Mark.
countered_by.why_en: Soul Furnace's shield absorbs Zed's burst, and Glory in Death keeps Sion fighting through Death Mark.

counters.why_ar: يتجاهل ضرر Zed الفيزيائي درع Void Stone السحري، وتلاحق Kassadin بـ Death Mark بعد Riftwalk.
counters.why_en: Zed's physical damage ignores Void Stone's magic shield, and Death Mark follows Kassadin's Riftwalk.

counters.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Syndra دون استهداف، وتضربها Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
counters.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Syndra untargetable, and Razor Shuriken hits through his shadows.

counters.why_ar: تجعل Death Mark بطلَ Zed غير قابل للاستهداف أثناء الاندفاع نحو Lillia، وتضربها Razor Shuriken مع الظلال.
counters.why_en: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable as he dashes onto Lillia, and Razor Shuriken hits through his shadows.

countered_by.why_ar: يدفع Zeri بـ Buster Shot بعيدًا عن مراوغتها، ويبطئها Rocket Jump.
countered_by.why_en: Buster Shot knocks Zeri back out of her kiting, and Rocket Jump slows her.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Yordle Snap Trap حركة Zeri ويبطئها 90 Caliber Net فيوقفان مراوغة Spark Surge.
countered_by.why_en: Yordle Snap Trap immobilizes Zeri and 90 Caliber Net slows her, stopping her Spark Surge kiting.

countered_by.why_ar: يلحق إبطاء Rend وضرره المتصاعد بـ Zeri، وتتفادى اندفاعات Martial Poise مهارة Burst Fire.
countered_by.why_en: Rend's slow and escalating damage catch Zeri, and Martial Poise lunges dodge Burst Fire.

counters.why_ar: يتفادى Spark Surge مهارة Piercing Arrow، وتبطئ Varus بـ Ultrashock Laser.
counters.why_en: Spark Surge dodges Piercing Arrow, and Ultrashock Laser slows Varus.

counters.why_ar: تبطئ Xayah بـ Ultrashock Laser، ويندفع Spark Surge خارج مدى تثبيت Bladecaller.
counters.why_en: Ultrashock Laser slows Xayah, and Spark Surge dashes out of Bladecaller's root range.

counters.why_ar: يبتعد Spark Surge عن إبطاء Venom Cask، وتتفوق سرعة Lightning Crash المتراكمة على Ambush.
counters.why_en: Spark Surge kites away from Venom Cask's slow, and Lightning Crash's stacking speed outruns Ambush.

countered_by.why_ar: تندفع Death Mark نحو Ziggs دون استهداف، ويمهّد Living Shadow للانفجار.
countered_by.why_en: Death Mark dashes onto Ziggs untargetable, and Living Shadow sets up the burst.

countered_by.why_ar: يشلّ Sear بطلَ Ziggs المشتعل بـ Blaze، وتعاقب Pillar of Flame ثباته أثناء الإلقاء.
countered_by.why_en: Sear stuns an ablaze Ziggs, and Pillar of Flame punishes his stand-still casting.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Justice Punch بـ Ziggs، ويخفف استفزاز Shield of Durand ودرع Hero's Entrance السحري ضرر قنابله.
countered_by.why_en: Justice Punch knocks Ziggs up, and Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance's magic shield blunt his bombs.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Kassadin بـ Satchel Charge بعيدًا، وتبطئ Hexplosive Minefield تتمة Riftwalk.
counters.why_en: Satchel Charge knocks Kassadin away, and Hexplosive Minefield slows his Riftwalk follow-up.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Aurora بـ Satchel Charge بعيدًا، وتبطئها Hexplosive Minefield بعد Across the Veil.
counters.why_en: Satchel Charge knocks Aurora away, and Hexplosive Minefield slows her after Across the Veil.

counters.why_ar: يدفع Lucian بـ Satchel Charge بعيدًا، وتبطئه Hexplosive Minefield.
counters.why_en: Satchel Charge knocks Lucian away, and Hexplosive Minefield slows him.

countered_by.why_ar: تسحب Zilean بـ Bone Skewer، وتُعدمه Death From Below.
countered_by.why_en: Bone Skewer pulls Zilean in, and Death From Below executes him.

countered_by.why_ar: يطيح Howling Gale بـ Zilean ويدفعه Monsoon للخلف قبل إصابة Time Bomb.
countered_by.why_en: Howling Gale knocks Zilean up and Monsoon knocks him back before Time Bomb lands.

countered_by.why_ar: يثبّت Zilean بـ Twisted Advance، ويثبّته جدار Nature's Grasp مجددًا.
countered_by.why_en: Twisted Advance roots Zilean, and Nature's Grasp's wall roots him again.

counters.why_ar: تبطئ Braum بـ Temporal Mirage ومقذوف Winter's Bite، فيبقى مكشوفًا لـ Time Bomb.
counters.why_en: Temporal Mirage slows Braum and his Winter's Bite, leaving him open to Time Bomb.

counters.why_ar: تبطئ Temporal Mirage مقذوف Dark Binding، وتسرّع Twisted Timeflow حركة Zilean.
counters.why_en: Temporal Mirage slows Dark Binding's projectile, and Twisted Timeflow speeds Zilean away.

counters.why_ar: يشلّ Seraphine بـ Time Bomb، وتبطئ Temporal Mirage مقذوفاتها.
counters.why_en: Time Bomb stuns Seraphine, and Temporal Mirage slows her projectiles.

countered_by.why_ar: يصدّ Wind Wall مقذوف Paddle Star وهو مصدر ضرر Zoe الرئيسي.
countered_by.why_en: Wind Wall blocks Paddle Star, Zoe's main damage source.

countered_by.why_ar: تجعل Chronobreak بطلَ Ekko غير قابل للاستهداف وتعيده قبل Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
countered_by.why_en: Chronobreak makes Ekko untargetable and rewinds past Sleepy Trouble Bubble.

countered_by.why_ar: تُسكت Zoe بـ Null Sphere، ويمتص درع Void Stone السحري ضررها.
countered_by.why_en: Null Sphere silences Zoe, and Void Stone's magic shield absorbs her damage.

counters.why_ar: تنيم Swain بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble، وتضربه Paddle Star.
counters.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Swain to sleep, and Paddle Star pokes him.

counters.why_ar: تنيم Lissandra بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble قبل Frozen Tomb، وتضربها Paddle Star.
counters.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Lissandra to sleep before Frozen Tomb, and Paddle Star pokes her.

counters.why_ar: تنيم Ahri بـ Sleepy Trouble Bubble بعد Spirit Rush.
counters.why_en: Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts Ahri to sleep after Spirit Rush.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Breath of Life تثبيت Grasping Roots عن الحلفاء، وتضيف Warm Hugs درعًا وسرعة.
countered_by.why_en: Breath of Life removes Grasping Roots' root from allies, and Warm Hugs adds shield and speed.

countered_by.why_ar: تزيل Unbreakable Will تثبيت Grasping Roots، ويغلق Headbutt المسافة نحو Zyra.
countered_by.why_en: Unbreakable Will removes the root from Grasping Roots, and Headbutt closes the gap on Zyra.

countered_by.why_ar: تشلّ Zyra بـ Crescendo وتتفوق Hymn of Valor عليها في الضرب من بعيد.
countered_by.why_en: Crescendo stuns Zyra and Hymn of Valor out-pokes her.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Rakan بـ Grasping Roots، وتطيح Stranglethorns به في الهواء.
counters.why_en: Grasping Roots roots Rakan, and Stranglethorns knock him airborne.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Pantheon بـ Grasping Roots، وتطيح Stranglethorns به في الهواء.
counters.why_en: Grasping Roots roots Pantheon, and Stranglethorns knock him airborne.

counters.why_ar: تثبّت Pyke بـ Grasping Roots بعد Phantom Undertow، وتواصل Thorn Spitters إيذاءه.
counters.why_en: Grasping Roots roots Pyke after Phantom Undertow, and Thorn Spitters keep damaging him.
